messages.summary:
## Objective
- Tambahkan konversi DOCX, PPTX, dan XLSX ke PDF dengan pratinjau sebelum diunduh.
- Tingkatkan ketajaman visual PDF hasil OCR tanpa menghilangkan lapisan teks yang dapat dicari.

## Requirements
- Pratinjau PDF hasil konversi Office sebelum unduhan.
- Pertahankan ketajaman visual halaman OCR dan kemampuan pencarian teks.

## Decisions
- Konversi Office dirancang berjalan di server dengan LibreOffice agar pratinjau dan unduhan konsisten.

## Work State
### Completed
- `runOcrPage()` merender halaman pada resolusi lebih tinggi dengan batas 3200 px dan 12 juta piksel, lalu menghasilkan PNG.
- `runOcr()` menggunakan PNG untuk tampilan halaman dan mempertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.

### Active
- Menambahkan unggah file Office, pratinjau PDF, dan unduh hasil konversi.

### Blocked
- Backend konversi Office belum tersedia; `libreoffice`/`soffice` tidak ditemukan dan repositori belum memiliki endpoint backend.
- Runtime hosting eksternal belum ditemukan memiliki implementasi backend konversi Office.

## Next Move
1. Tentukan cara menyediakan endpoint server-side LibreOffice di runtime hosting.
2. Implementasikan endpoint konversi Office dengan validasi format dan batas unggahan.
3. Tambahkan UI unggah DOCX/PPTX/XLSX, pratinjau PDF, dan unduh.
4. Uji ketajaman hasil OCR serta kemampuan pencarian teks.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: fungsi OCR, definisi alat, serta alur modal/pratinjau.
- `index.html`: antarmuka aplikasi dan elemen modal.
- `styles.css`: styling modal dan pratinjau.
- `start.sh`: menjalankan runtime hosting eksternal.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: entry point runtime hosting.

## Important Context
- Aplikasi saat ini memproses PDF lokal di browser; validasi unggahan yang ada menerima PDF atau gambar.
- Perubahan OCR di `app.js`, `index.html`, dan `styles.css` belum di-commit.
- `app.js` mendaftarkan alat di `tools` dan `toolGroups`; `openTool()`, `addFiles()`, dan `processTool()` mengatur unggah dan pemrosesan. `BATCH_TOOLS` berisi alat yang menerima banyak file.
- Runtime saat ini menyajikan aplikasi statis.

## Objective
- Tambahkan konversi DOCX, PPTX, dan XLSX ke PDF dengan pratinjau sebelum diunduh.
- Tingkatkan ketajaman visual PDF hasil OCR tanpa menghilangkan lapisan teks yang dapat dicari.

## Requirements
- Pratinjau PDF hasil konversi Office sebelum unduhan.
- Pertahankan ketajaman visual halaman OCR dan kemampuan pencarian teks.

## Decisions
- Konversi Office menggunakan LibreOffice di server agar pratinjau dan unduhan konsisten.

## Work State
### Completed
- `runOcrPage()` merender halaman OCR beresolusi lebih tinggi dengan batas 3200 px dan 12 juta piksel sebagai PNG.

- `app.js` memiliki entri alat `officeToPdf`, alat itu dimasukkan ke grup `konversi`, dan variabel `officePreviewUrl` telah ditambahkan.

### Active
- Menyelesaikan fitur konversi Office, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan.

### Blocked
- Belum ada endpoint backend untuk konversi Office; `libreoffice`/`soffice` belum ditemukan, dan runtime yang diperiksa hanya menyajikan berkas statis.

## Next Move
1. Tentukan cara menyediakan endpoint LibreOffice server-side pada runtime hosting.
2. Implementasikan endpoint konversi dengan validasi format dan batas unggahan.

4. Uji ketajaman hasil OCR serta kemampuan pencarian teks.

- `app.js`: alat, unggah dan pemrosesan file, perubahan OCR, serta entri `officeToPdf`.

- `start.sh`: menjalankan runtime hosting eksternal.

- `app.js` mengatur alat lewat `tools` dan `toolGroups`; `openTool()`, `addFiles()`, dan `processTool()` mengatur unggah dan pemrosesan file. `BATCH_TOOLS` menangani alat multi-file.
- Percobaan mengedit entri alat `toJpg` pertama gagal karena teks yang dicari tidak cocok; percobaan berikutnya berhasil menambahkan entri `officeToPdf`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Tambahkan konversi DOCX, PPTX, dan XLSX ke PDF dengan pratinjau sebelum diunduh.
- Tingkatkan ketajaman visual PDF hasil OCR tanpa menghilangkan lapisan teks yang dapat dicari.

## Requirements
- Pratinjau PDF hasil konversi Office sebelum unduhan.
- Pertahankan ketajaman visual halaman OCR dan kemampuan pencarian teks.

## Decisions
- Konversi Office menggunakan LibreOffice di server agar pratinjau dan unduhan konsisten.

## Work State
### Completed
- `runOcrPage()` merender halaman OCR beresolusi lebih tinggi dengan batas 3200 px dan 12 juta piksel sebagai PNG.
- `runOcr()` memakai PNG untuk tampilan halaman dan mempertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.
- `app.js` memiliki entri alat `officeToPdf`, alat itu dimasukkan ke grup `konversi`, dan variabel `officePreviewUrl` telah ditambahkan.

### Active
- Menentukan dan mengimplementasikan alur server-side konversi Office, pratinjau, dan unduhan.

### Blocked
- Belum ada endpoint backend untuk konversi Office; `libreoffice`/`soffice` belum ditemukan, dan runtime yang diperiksa hanya menyajikan berkas statis.

## Next Move
1. Tentukan cara menyediakan endpoint LibreOffice server-side pada runtime hosting.
2. Implementasikan endpoint konversi dengan validasi format dan batas unggahan.
3. Lengkapi UI unggah DOCX/PPTX/XLSX, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan hasil.
4. Uji ketajaman hasil OCR serta kemampuan pencarian teks.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: alat, unggah dan pemrosesan file, perubahan OCR, serta entri `officeToPdf`.
- `index.html`: antarmuka aplikasi dan elemen modal/pratinjau.
- `styles.css`: styling antarmuka dan modal.
- `start.sh`: menjalankan runtime hosting eksternal.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: entry point runtime hosting yang diperiksa; saat ini menyajikan aplikasi statis.

## Important Context
- Aplikasi saat ini memproses PDF lokal di browser; validasi unggahan yang ada menerima PDF atau gambar.
- Perubahan di `app.js`, `index.html`, dan `styles.css` belum di-commit.
- `app.js` mengatur alat lewat `tools` dan `toolGroups`; `openTool()`, `addFiles()`, dan `processTool()` mengatur unggah dan pemrosesan file. `BATCH_TOOLS` menangani alat multi-file.
- Percobaan mengedit entri alat `toJpg` pertama gagal karena teks yang dicari tidak cocok; percobaan berikutnya berhasil menambahkan entri `officeToPdf`.

## Objective
- Tambahkan konversi DOCX, PPTX, dan XLSX ke PDF dengan pratinjau sebelum diunduh.
- Tingkatkan ketajaman visual PDF hasil OCR tanpa menghilangkan lapisan teks yang dapat dicari.

## Requirements
- Pratinjau PDF hasil konversi Office sebelum unduhan.
- Pertahankan ketajaman visual halaman OCR dan kemampuan pencarian teks.

## Decisions
- Konversi Office direncanakan memakai LibreOffice di server agar pratinjau dan unduhan konsisten.

## Work State
### Completed
- `runOcrPage()` merender halaman OCR sebagai PNG beresolusi lebih tinggi, dengan batas 3200 px dan 12 juta piksel.
- `runOcr()` memakai PNG untuk tampilan halaman dan mempertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.
- `app.js` memiliki alat `officeToPdf` dalam grup `konversi` serta variabel `officePreviewUrl`.

### Active
- Menentukan arsitektur server-side untuk konversi Office, pratinjau, dan unduhan; implementasi belum dimulai.

### Blocked
- Runtime yang diperiksa hanya menyajikan berkas statis, dan `libreoffice`/`soffice` tidak tersedia; belum ada endpoint backend konversi Office.

## Next Move
1. Tentukan bagaimana menyediakan endpoint LibreOffice server-side pada runtime hosting.
2. Implementasikan endpoint konversi dengan validasi format dan batas unggahan.
3. Lengkapi UI unggah DOCX/PPTX/XLSX, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan hasil.
4. Uji ketajaman hasil OCR serta kemampuan pencarian teks.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: alat Office masih belum terhubung; alur unggah/pemrosesan dan OCR.
- `index.html`: antarmuka unggah dan modal pratinjau.
- `styles.css`: styling antarmuka dan modal.
- `start.sh`: menjalankan runtime hosting eksternal.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: runtime hosting yang diperiksa; saat ini menyajikan berkas statis.

## Important Context
- Aplikasi saat ini memproses PDF lokal di browser; validasi unggahan hanya menerima PDF atau gambar.
- Perubahan di `app.js`, `index.html`, dan `styles.css` belum di-commit.
- `openTool()`, `addFiles()`, dan `processTool()` mengatur unggah dan pemrosesan file; `BATCH_TOOLS` menangani alat multi-file.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Tambahkan konversi DOCX, PPTX, dan XLSX ke PDF dengan pratinjau sebelum diunduh.
- Tingkatkan ketajaman visual PDF hasil OCR tanpa menghilangkan lapisan teks yang dapat dicari.

## Requirements
- Pratinjau PDF hasil konversi Office sebelum unduhan.
- Pertahankan ketajaman visual halaman OCR dan kemampuan pencarian teks.

## Decisions
- Konversi Office direncanakan memakai LibreOffice di server agar pratinjau dan unduhan konsisten.

## Work State
### Completed
- `runOcrPage()` merender halaman OCR sebagai PNG beresolusi lebih tinggi, dengan batas 3200 px dan 12 juta piksel.
- `runOcr()` memakai PNG untuk tampilan halaman dan mempertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.
- `app.js` sudah memiliki alat `officeToPdf` dalam grup `konversi` serta variabel `officePreviewUrl`.

### Active
- Menentukan arsitektur server-side untuk konversi Office, pratinjau, dan unduhan.
- Melanjutkan implementasi UI dan alur unggah/pemrosesan Office.

### Blocked
- Runtime hosting yang diperiksa hanya menyajikan berkas statis, dan `libreoffice`/`soffice` tidak tersedia; belum ada endpoint backend konversi Office.

## Next Move
1. Tentukan bagaimana menyediakan endpoint LibreOffice server-side pada runtime hosting.
2. Implementasikan endpoint konversi dengan validasi format dan batas unggahan.
3. Lengkapi UI unggah DOCX/PPTX/XLSX, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan hasil.
4. Uji ketajaman hasil OCR serta kemampuan pencarian teks.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: alat Office belum terhubung; alur unggah/pemrosesan file dan OCR.
- `index.html`: antarmuka unggah dan modal pratinjau.
- `styles.css`: styling antarmuka dan modal.
- `start.sh`: menjalankan runtime hosting eksternal.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: runtime hosting yang diperiksa; saat ini menyajikan berkas statis.

## Important Context
- Aplikasi saat ini memproses PDF lokal di browser; validasi unggahan hanya menerima PDF atau gambar.
- Perubahan di `app.js`, `index.html`, dan `styles.css` belum di-commit.
- `openTool()`, `addFiles()`, dan `processTool()` mengatur unggah dan pemrosesan file; `BATCH_TOOLS` menangani alat multi-file.

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Tambahkan konversi DOCX, PPTX, dan XLSX ke PDF dengan pratinjau sebelum diunduh.
- Tingkatkan ketajaman visual PDF hasil OCR tanpa menghilangkan lapisan teks yang dapat dicari.

## Requirements
- Pratinjau PDF hasil konversi Office sebelum unduhan.
- Pertahankan ketajaman visual halaman OCR dan kemampuan pencarian teks.

## Decisions
- Konversi Office direncanakan memakai LibreOffice di server agar pratinjau dan unduhan konsisten.

## Work State
### Completed
- `runOcrPage()` merender halaman OCR sebagai PNG beresolusi lebih tinggi, dengan batas 3200 px dan 12 juta piksel.
- `runOcr()` memakai PNG untuk tampilan halaman dan mempertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.
- `app.js` memiliki alat `officeToPdf` dalam grup `konversi` serta variabel `officePreviewUrl`.
- Perubahan di `app.js`, `index.html`, dan `styles.css` masih belum di-commit.

### Active
- Menentukan arsitektur server-side untuk konversi Office, pratinjau, dan unduhan.
- Melanjutkan implementasi UI dan alur unggah/pemrosesan Office.

### Blocked
- Runtime hosting yang diperiksa hanya menyajikan berkas statis; `libreoffice`/`soffice` tidak tersedia dan belum ada endpoint backend konversi Office.

## Next Move
1. Tentukan bagaimana menyediakan endpoint LibreOffice server-side pada runtime hosting.
2. Implementasikan endpoint konversi dengan validasi format dan batas unggahan.
3. Lengkapi UI unggah DOCX/PPTX/XLSX, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan hasil.
4. Uji ketajaman hasil OCR serta kemampuan pencarian teks.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: alat Office belum terhubung; alur unggah/pemrosesan file dan OCR.
- `index.html`: antarmuka unggah dan modal pratinjau.
- `styles.css`: styling antarmuka dan modal.
- `start.sh`: menjalankan runtime hosting eksternal.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: runtime hosting yang diperiksa; saat ini menyajikan berkas statis.

## Important Context
- Aplikasi saat ini memproses PDF lokal di browser; validasi unggahan hanya menerima PDF atau gambar.
- `openTool()`, `addFiles()`, dan `processTool()` mengatur unggah dan pemrosesan file; `BATCH_TOOLS` menangani alat multi-file.

## Objective
- Tambahkan konversi DOCX, PPTX, dan XLSX ke PDF dengan pratinjau sebelum diunduh.
- Tingkatkan ketajaman visual PDF hasil OCR tanpa menghilangkan lapisan teks yang dapat dicari.

## Requirements
- Pratinjau PDF hasil konversi Office sebelum unduhan.
- Pertahankan ketajaman visual halaman OCR dan kemampuan pencarian teks.

## Decisions
- Konversi Office direncanakan memakai LibreOffice di server agar pratinjau dan unduhan konsisten.

## Work State

### Completed
- `runOcrPage()` merender halaman OCR sebagai PNG beresolusi lebih tinggi, dengan batas 3200 px dan 12 juta piksel.
- `runOcr()` memakai PNG untuk tampilan halaman dan mempertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.
- `app.js` memiliki entri alat `officeToPdf` dalam grup `konversi` serta variabel `officePreviewUrl`.

### Active
- Menentukan arsitektur server-side untuk konversi Office, pratinjau, dan unduhan.
- Melanjutkan implementasi UI dan alur unggah/pemrosesan Office.

### Blocked
- Runtime hosting yang diperiksa hanya menyajikan berkas statis; `libreoffice`/`soffice` tidak tersedia dan belum ada endpoint backend konversi Office.

## Next Move
1. Tentukan bagaimana menyediakan endpoint LibreOffice server-side pada runtime hosting.
2. Implementasikan endpoint konversi dengan validasi format dan batas unggahan.
3. Lengkapi UI unggah DOCX/PPTX/XLSX, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan hasil.
4. Uji ketajaman hasil OCR serta kemampuan pencarian teks.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: alat Office belum terhubung; alur unggah/pemrosesan file dan OCR.
- `index.html`: antarmuka unggah dan modal pratinjau.
- `styles.css`: styling antarmuka dan modal.
- `start.sh`: menjalankan runtime hosting eksternal.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: runtime hosting yang diperiksa; saat ini menyajikan berkas statis.

## Important Context
- Aplikasi saat ini memproses PDF lokal di browser; validasi unggahan hanya menerima PDF atau gambar.
- `openTool()`, `addFiles()`, dan `processTool()` mengatur unggah dan pemrosesan file; `BATCH_TOOLS` menangani alat multi-file.
- Perubahan di `app.js`, `index.html`, dan `styles.css` belum di-commit.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Tambahkan konversi DOCX, PPTX, dan XLSX ke PDF dengan pratinjau sebelum diunduh.
- Tingkatkan ketajaman visual PDF hasil OCR tanpa menghilangkan lapisan teks yang dapat dicari.

## Requirements
- Pratinjau PDF hasil konversi Office sebelum unduhan.
- Pertahankan ketajaman visual halaman OCR dan kemampuan pencarian teks.
- Validasi format berkas serta batas ukuran unggahan.

## Decisions
- Sediakan backend Node + LibreOffice terpisah; UI memanggil URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi.
- Lakukan konversi LibreOffice di server agar pratinjau dan unduhan konsisten.

## Work State

### Completed
- `runOcrPage()` merender halaman OCR sebagai PNG beresolusi lebih tinggi, dibatasi 3200 px dan 12 juta piksel.
- `runOcr()` memakai PNG untuk tampilan halaman dan mempertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.
- `app.js` mendaftarkan alat `officeToPdf` dalam grup `konversi` dan mendeklarasikan `officePreviewUrl`.

### Active
- Implementasikan layanan API Node + LibreOffice sebagai layanan terpisah.
- Lengkapi alur unggah DOCX/PPTX/XLSX, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan hasil di UI.
- Tambahkan validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan pada endpoint.
- Uji ketajaman OCR dan pencarian teks.

### Blocked
- Runtime hosting yang diperiksa hanya menyajikan berkas statis; backend konversi belum tersedia atau diimplementasikan.
- Konversi belum dapat diuji dengan LibreOffice; executable `libreoffice`/`soffice` tidak ditemukan di lingkungan pemeriksaan.

## Next Move
1. Implementasikan layanan API Node + LibreOffice sebagai layanan terpisah.
2. Tambahkan validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan pada endpoint.
3. Hubungkan UI ke URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi dan lengkapi pratinjau serta unduhan PDF.
4. Jalankan pengujian OCR untuk ketajaman visual dan ketercarian teks.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: alat Office, alur unggah/pemrosesan berkas, dan OCR.
- `index.html`: antarmuka unggah dan modal pratinjau.
- `styles.css`: styling antarmuka dan modal.
- `start.sh`: menjalankan runtime hosting eksternal.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: runtime hosting yang diperiksa; hanya menyajikan berkas statis.

## Important Context
- Perubahan pada `app.js`, `index.html`, dan `styles.css` belum di-commit; status git terakhir menunjukkan ketiganya dimodifikasi.
- `addFiles()` saat ini menerima PDF atau gambar; `fileInput.accept` belum diatur untuk DOCX/PPTX/XLSX.
- `processTool()` belum memiliki kasus konversi Office.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Tambahkan konversi DOCX, PPTX, dan XLSX ke PDF dengan pratinjau sebelum diunduh.
- Tingkatkan ketajaman visual PDF hasil OCR tanpa menghilangkan lapisan teks yang dapat dicari.

## Requirements
- Pratinjau PDF hasil konversi Office sebelum unduhan.
- Pertahankan ketajaman visual halaman OCR dan kemampuan pencarian teks.
- Validasi format berkas serta batas ukuran unggahan.

## Decisions
- Sediakan backend Node + LibreOffice terpisah; UI memanggil URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi.
- Lakukan konversi LibreOffice di server agar pratinjau dan unduhan konsisten.

## Work State

### Completed
- `runOcrPage()` merender halaman OCR sebagai PNG beresolusi lebih tinggi, dibatasi 3200 px dan 12 juta piksel.
- `runOcr()` memakai PNG untuk tampilan halaman dan mempertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.
- `app.js` mendaftarkan alat `officeToPdf` dalam grup `konversi` dan mendeklarasikan `officePreviewUrl`.

### Active
- Implementasikan layanan API Node + LibreOffice sebagai layanan terpisah.
- Lengkapi alur unggah DOCX/PPTX/XLSX, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan hasil di UI.
- Tambahkan validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan pada endpoint.
- Uji ketajaman OCR dan pencarian teks.

### Blocked
- Runtime hosting yang diperiksa hanya menyajikan berkas statis; backend konversi belum tersedia atau diimplementasikan.
- Konversi belum dapat diuji dengan LibreOffice; executable `libreoffice`/`soffice` tidak ditemukan di lingkungan pemeriksaan.

## Next Move
1. Implementasikan layanan API Node + LibreOffice sebagai layanan terpisah.
2. Tambahkan validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan pada endpoint.
3. Hubungkan UI ke URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi dan lengkapi pratinjau serta unduhan PDF.
4. Jalankan pengujian OCR untuk ketajaman visual dan ketercarian teks.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: alat Office, alur unggah/pemrosesan berkas, dan OCR.
- `index.html`: antarmuka unggah dan modal pratinjau.
- `styles.css`: styling antarmuka dan modal.
- `start.sh`: menjalankan runtime hosting eksternal.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: runtime hosting yang diperiksa; hanya menyajikan berkas statis.

## Important Context
- Perubahan pada `app.js`, `index.html`, dan `styles.css` belum di-commit; status git terakhir menunjukkan ketiganya dimodifikasi.
- `addFiles()` saat ini menerima PDF atau gambar; `fileInput.accept` belum diatur untuk DOCX/PPTX/XLSX.
- `processTool()` belum memiliki kasus konversi Office.
- Modal pratinjau Office dan layanan konversi belum tampak diimplementasikan.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Tambahkan konversi DOCX, PPTX, dan XLSX ke PDF dengan pratinjau sebelum diunduh.
- Pertahankan ketajaman visual PDF hasil OCR sekaligus menjaga teks tetap dapat dicari.

## Requirements
- Pratinjau PDF hasil konversi Office sebelum unduhan.
- Validasi format berkas serta batas ukuran unggahan.
- Pertahankan visual tajam dan teks yang dapat dicari pada hasil OCR.

## Decisions
- Sediakan backend Node + LibreOffice terpisah; UI memanggil URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi.
- Lakukan konversi LibreOffice di server agar pratinjau dan unduhan konsisten.

## Work State
### Completed
- `runOcrPage()` merender halaman OCR sebagai PNG beresolusi lebih tinggi, dibatasi 3200 px dan 12 juta piksel.
- `runOcr()` menggunakan PNG untuk tampilan halaman dan mempertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.
- `app.js` mendaftarkan alat `officeToPdf` dalam grup `konversi` dan mendeklarasikan `officePreviewUrl`.

### Active
- Implementasikan layanan API Node + LibreOffice sebagai layanan terpisah.
- Lengkapi alur unggah DOCX/PPTX/XLSX, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan hasil di UI.
- Tambahkan validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan pada endpoint.
- Uji ketajaman OCR dan pencarian teks.

### Blocked
- Runtime hosting yang diperiksa hanya menyajikan berkas statis; backend konversi belum tersedia atau diimplementasikan.
- Konversi belum dapat diuji dengan LibreOffice; executable `libreoffice`/`soffice` tidak ditemukan di lingkungan pemeriksaan.

## Next Move
1. Implementasikan layanan API Node + LibreOffice, termasuk validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan.
2. Hubungkan UI ke URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi; tambahkan pilihan file Office, konversi, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan.
3. Jalankan pengujian OCR untuk ketajaman visual dan ketercarian teks.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: alat Office, pengaturan pemilihan berkas, pemrosesan alat, dan OCR.
- `index.html`: antarmuka unggah dan modal pratinjau.
- `styles.css`: styling antarmuka dan modal.
- `start.sh`: menjalankan runtime hosting eksternal.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: runtime hosting yang diperiksa; hanya menyajikan berkas statis.

## Important Context
- Perubahan pada `app.js`, `index.html`, dan `styles.css` belum di-commit; status git terakhir menunjukkan ketiganya dimodifikasi.
- `addFiles()` saat ini menerima PDF atau gambar; `fileInput.accept` belum mencakup DOCX/PPTX/XLSX.
- `processTool()` belum memiliki kasus konversi Office.
- Modal pratinjau Office dan layanan konversi belum tampak diimplementasikan.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Tambahkan konversi DOCX, PPTX, dan XLSX ke PDF dengan pratinjau sebelum diunduh.
- Jaga hasil OCR tetap tajam secara visual dan teksnya dapat dicari.

## Requirements
- Pratinjau PDF hasil konversi Office sebelum unduhan.
- Validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan.
- Pertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.

## Decisions
- Sediakan backend Node + LibreOffice terpisah; UI memanggil URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi.
- Lakukan konversi di server agar pratinjau dan unduhan konsisten.

## Work State
### Completed
- `app.js` mendaftarkan alat `officeToPdf` dalam grup `konversi` dan mendeklarasikan `officePreviewUrl`.
- OCR merender halaman sebagai PNG beresolusi lebih tinggi, dibatasi 3200 px dan 12 juta piksel, sambil mempertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.

### Active
- Implementasikan layanan API Node + LibreOffice.
- Lengkapi alur unggah DOCX/PPTX/XLSX, konversi, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan di UI.
- Tambahkan validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan; uji kualitas visual serta pencarian teks OCR.

### Blocked
- Runtime hosting yang diperiksa hanya menyajikan berkas statis; backend konversi belum tersedia atau diimplementasikan.
- Konversi LibreOffice belum dapat diuji karena `libreoffice`/`soffice` tidak ditemukan di lingkungan pemeriksaan.

## Next Move
1. Implementasikan layanan API Node + LibreOffice dengan validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan.
2. Hubungkan UI ke URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi; tambahkan pemilihan berkas Office, konversi, pratinjau, dan unduhan.
3. Jalankan pengujian OCR untuk ketajaman visual dan ketercarian teks.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: alat Office, pemilihan berkas, pemrosesan alat, dan OCR.
- `index.html`: antarmuka unggah dan modal pratinjau.
- `styles.css`: styling antarmuka dan modal.
- `start.sh`: menjalankan runtime hosting eksternal.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: runtime hosting yang diperiksa; hanya menyajikan berkas statis.

## Important Context
- Perubahan pada `app.js`, `index.html`, dan `styles.css` belum di-commit.
- `addFiles()` saat ini menerima PDF atau gambar; `fileInput.accept` belum mencakup DOCX/PPTX/XLSX.
- `processTool()` belum memiliki kasus konversi Office; modal pratinjau Office dan layanan konversi belum tampak diimplementasikan.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Tambahkan konversi DOCX, PPTX, dan XLSX ke PDF dengan pratinjau sebelum diunduh.
- Jaga hasil OCR tetap tajam secara visual dan teksnya dapat dicari.

## Requirements
- Pratinjau PDF hasil konversi Office sebelum unduhan.
- Validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan.
- Pertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.

## Decisions
- Sediakan backend Node + LibreOffice terpisah; UI memanggil URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi.
- Lakukan konversi di server agar pratinjau dan unduhan konsisten.

## Work State
### Completed
- `app.js` mendaftarkan alat `officeToPdf` dalam grup `konversi` dan mendeklarasikan `officePreviewUrl`.
- OCR merender halaman sebagai PNG beresolusi lebih tinggi, dibatasi 3200 px dan 12 juta piksel, sambil mempertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.

### Active
- Implementasikan layanan API Node + LibreOffice.
- Lengkapi alur unggah DOCX/PPTX/XLSX, konversi, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan di UI.
- Tambahkan validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan; uji kualitas visual serta pencarian teks OCR.

### Blocked
- Runtime hosting yang diperiksa hanya menyajikan berkas statis; backend konversi belum tersedia atau diimplementasikan.
- Konversi LibreOffice belum dapat diuji karena `libreoffice`/`soffice` tidak ditemukan di lingkungan pemeriksaan.

## Next Move
1. Implementasikan layanan API Node + LibreOffice dengan validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan.
2. Hubungkan UI ke URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi; tambahkan pemilihan berkas Office, konversi, pratinjau, dan unduhan.
3. Jalankan pengujian OCR untuk ketajaman visual dan ketercarian teks.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: alat Office, pemilihan berkas, pemrosesan alat, dan OCR.
- `index.html`: antarmuka unggah dan modal pratinjau.
- `styles.css`: styling antarmuka dan modal.
- `start.sh`: menjalankan runtime hosting eksternal.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: runtime hosting yang diperiksa; hanya menyajikan berkas statis.

## Important Context
- Perubahan pada `app.js`, `index.html`, dan `styles.css` belum di-commit.
- `addFiles()` saat ini menerima PDF atau gambar; `fileInput.accept` belum mencakup DOCX/PPTX/XLSX.
- `processTool()` belum memiliki kasus konversi Office; modal pratinjau Office dan layanan konversi belum diimplementasikan.
- Pemeriksaan terbaru membaca alur modal, pemilih file, dan pemrosesan `processTool()`; belum ada perubahan kode baru dari pemeriksaan itu.

- Validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan.
- Pertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.

## Decisions
- Sediakan backend Node + LibreOffice terpisah; UI memanggil URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi.
- Lakukan konversi di server agar pratinjau dan unduhan konsisten.

### Completed

- Hubungkan alur unggah Office, konversi, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan di UI.

## Objective
- Tambahkan konversi DOCX, PPTX, dan XLSX ke PDF dengan pratinjau sebelum diunduh.
- Jaga hasil OCR tetap tajam secara visual dan teksnya dapat dicari.

## Requirements
- Pratinjau PDF hasil konversi Office sebelum unduhan.
- Validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan.
- Pertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.

## Decisions
- Sediakan backend Node + LibreOffice terpisah; UI memanggil URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi.
- Lakukan konversi di server agar pratinjau dan unduhan konsisten.

## Work State

### Completed
- `app.js` mendaftarkan alat `officeToPdf` dalam grup `konversi` dan mendeklarasikan `officePreviewUrl`.
- OCR merender halaman sebagai PNG beresolusi lebih tinggi, dibatasi 3200 px dan 12 juta piksel, sambil mempertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.

### Active
- Implementasikan layanan API Node + LibreOffice dengan validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan.
- Hubungkan alur unggah Office, konversi, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan di UI.
- Tambahkan dan jalankan pengujian OCR untuk kualitas visual dan ketercarian teks.

### Blocked
- Runtime hosting yang diperiksa hanya menyajikan berkas statis; backend konversi belum tersedia atau diimplementasikan.
- Konversi LibreOffice belum dapat diuji karena `libreoffice`/`soffice` tidak ditemukan di lingkungan pemeriksaan.

## Next Move
1. Implementasikan layanan API Node + LibreOffice yang memvalidasi ekstensi/MIME dan ukuran unggahan.
2. Lengkapi pemilih file Office, koneksi ke URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan.
3. Jalankan pengujian OCR untuk ketajaman visual serta ketercarian teks.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: alat Office sudah terdaftar, tetapi pemilihan file dan pemrosesan Office belum terhubung; OCR memakai renderer resolusi tinggi.
- `index.html`: modal alat belum memiliki antarmuka pratinjau Office.
- `styles.css`: styling UI dan modal.
- `start.sh`: menjalankan runtime hosting eksternal; runtime yang diperiksa hanya menyajikan berkas statis.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: runtime hosting yang diperiksa.

## Important Context
- `app.js`, `index.html`, dan `styles.css` masih memiliki perubahan belum di-commit.
- `addFiles()` masih menerima PDF atau gambar; `fileInput.accept` belum mencakup DOCX/PPTX/XLSX.
- `processTool()` belum memiliki kasus konversi Office; `closeModal()` belum mengelola URL pratinjau Office.
- Tidak ada `package.json` di root proyek.

## Objective
- Tambahkan konversi DOCX, PPTX, dan XLSX ke PDF dengan pratinjau sebelum diunduh.
- Jaga hasil OCR tetap tajam secara visual dan teksnya dapat dicari.

## Requirements
- Pratinjau PDF hasil konversi Office sebelum unduhan.
- Validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan.
- Pertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.

## Decisions
- Sediakan backend Node + LibreOffice terpisah; UI memanggil URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi.
- Lakukan konversi di server agar pratinjau dan unduhan konsisten.

## Work State
### Completed
- `app.js` mendaftarkan alat `officeToPdf` dalam grup `konversi` dan mendeklarasikan `officePreviewUrl`.
- OCR merender halaman sebagai PNG beresolusi lebih tinggi, dibatasi 3200 px dan 12 juta piksel, sambil mempertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.

### Active
- Implementasikan layanan API Node + LibreOffice dengan validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan.
- Hubungkan pemilih file Office, URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan di UI.
- Tambahkan dan jalankan pengujian OCR untuk kualitas visual dan ketercarian teks.

### Blocked
- Runtime hosting yang diperiksa hanya menyajikan berkas statis; backend konversi belum tersedia atau diimplementasikan.
- Konversi LibreOffice belum dapat diuji karena `libreoffice`/`soffice` tidak ditemukan di lingkungan pemeriksaan.

## Next Move
1. Implementasikan layanan API Node + LibreOffice yang memvalidasi ekstensi/MIME dan ukuran unggahan.
2. Lengkapi alur Office di UI: pemilih file, koneksi ke API, pratinjau, dan unduhan.
3. Jalankan pengujian OCR untuk ketajaman visual serta ketercarian teks.

- `index.html`: modal alat belum memiliki antarmuka pratinjau Office.
- `styles.css`: styling UI dan modal.
- `start.sh`: menjalankan runtime hosting eksternal.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: runtime hosting yang diperiksa; hanya menyajikan berkas statis.

## Important Context
- `app.js`, `index.html`, dan `styles.css` memiliki perubahan belum di-commit.
- `addFiles()` masih menerima PDF atau gambar; `fileInput.accept` belum mencakup DOCX/PPTX/XLSX.
- `processTool()` belum memiliki kasus konversi Office; `closeModal()` belum mengelola URL pratinjau Office.
- Tidak ada `package.json` di root proyek.
- Node v24.22.3 dan npm 11.19.0 tersedia; `libreoffice` dan `soffice` tidak ditemukan.

## Objective
- Tambahkan konversi DOCX, PPTX, dan XLSX ke PDF dengan pratinjau sebelum diunduh.
- Jaga hasil OCR tetap tajam secara visual dan teksnya dapat dicari.

## Requirements
- Pratinjau PDF hasil konversi Office sebelum unduhan.
- Validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan.
- Pertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.

## Decisions
- Sediakan backend Node + LibreOffice terpisah; UI memanggil URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi.
- Lakukan konversi di server agar pratinjau dan unduhan konsisten.

## Work State
### Completed
- `app.js` mendaftarkan alat `officeToPdf` dalam grup `konversi` dan mendeklarasikan `officePreviewUrl`.
- OCR merender halaman sebagai PNG beresolusi lebih tinggi, dibatasi 3200 px dan 12 juta piksel, sambil mempertahankan teks OCR tersembunyi yang dapat dicari.

### Active
- Implementasikan layanan API Node + LibreOffice dengan validasi ekstensi/MIME dan batas ukuran unggahan.
- Lengkapi alur Office di UI: pemilih file, URL API yang dapat dikonfigurasi, pratinjau PDF, dan unduhan.
- Tambahkan dan jalankan pengujian OCR untuk kualitas visual dan ketercarian teks.

### Blocked
- Runtime hosting yang diperiksa hanya menyajikan berkas statis; backend konversi belum tersedia atau diimplementasikan.
- Konversi LibreOffice belum dapat diuji karena `libreoffice`/`soffice` tidak ditemukan di lingkungan pemeriksaan.

## Next Move
1. Implementasikan layanan API Node + LibreOffice dengan validasi ekstensi/MIME dan ukuran unggahan.
2. Hubungkan pemilih file Office, URL API, pratinjau, dan unduhan di UI.
3. Jalankan pengujian OCR untuk ketajaman visual serta ketercarian teks.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: alat Office sudah terdaftar, tetapi `addFiles()` hanya menerima PDF/gambar dan `processTool()` belum memproses Office.
- `index.html`: modal alat belum memiliki antarmuka pratinjau Office.
- `styles.css`: styling UI dan modal.
- `start.sh`: menjalankan runtime hosting eksternal.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: runtime hosting yang diperiksa; hanya menyajikan berkas statis.

## Important Context
- `app.js`, `index.html`, dan `styles.css` memiliki perubahan belum di-commit.
- `closeModal()` belum mengelola URL pratinjau Office.
- Tidak ada `package.json` di root proyek. Node v24.22.3 dan npm 11.19.1 tersedia; `libreoffice` dan `soffice` tidak ditemukan.

## Objective
- Add DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX conversion to PDF with preview before download.
- Keep OCR output visually sharp and text searchable without breaking hidden text layers.

## Requirements
- Preview the converted PDF before download.
- Validate upload extension/MIME and size limits.
- Maintain hidden searchable OCR text in output.
- Use a separate Node + LibreOffice backend so preview and download stay consistent.
- Keep UI configurable with an API URL for conversion requests.
- Do not rely on browser-only processing for Office files.

## Decisions
- Convert Office files on the server using LibreOffice, not in the browser.
- Keep the frontend and backend separate so preview/download behavior matches.
- Use a configurable API base URL in the UI for the Office conversion service.
- Render OCR pages at higher resolution while preserving searchable hidden text layers.

## Work State
Break the objective into smaller goals and report which are completed, which are being worked on, and which are blocked.
### Completed
- `app.js` registers the `officeToPdf` tool in the `konversi` group and declares `officePreviewUrl`.
- OCR rendering now uses higher-resolution PNG output with a 3200 px cap and a 12M-pixel limit while preserving hidden searchable OCR text.
- The working tree shows the expected UI/file changes in `app.js`, `index.html`, and `styles.css`.

### Active
- Implement the Node + LibreOffice Office conversion API with upload validation.
- Complete the Office conversion flow in the UI: file picker, configurable API URL, PDF preview, and download handling.
- Add and run OCR quality checks for visual sharpness and searchable text fidelity.

### Blocked
- The runtime hosting under inspection only serves static files; the Office conversion backend is not yet implemented or exposed.
- `libreoffice`/`soffice` is not installed in the current environment, so conversion cannot be tested here.

## Next Move
1. Implement the Node + LibreOffice API service with extension/MIME validation and upload size enforcement.
2. Connect the Office file picker, API URL configuration, preview rendering, and download flow in the UI.
3. Run OCR verification for visual clarity and searchability before finalizing the Office conversion flow.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: Office tool registration and processing logic.
- `index.html`: Office modal and client-side conversion UI.
- `styles.css`: styling for the Office preview and conversion modal.
- `start.sh`: launch script for the project runtime.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: checked runtime host, currently static-only.
- `/home/runner/work/PDF-Tools-Ai-Project/PDF-Tools-Ai-Project`: project root for the active work.

## Important Context
- `app.js`, `index.html`, and `styles.css` are modified but not yet committed.
- `closeModal()` does not yet handle the Office preview URL lifecycle.
- There is no `package.json` at the project root.
- The current runtime only serves static files; a backend conversion service is still missing.
- `libreoffice` and `soffice` are not available in the checked environment, so backend conversion remains unverified.

## Objective
- Add DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX conversion to PDF with a preview before download.
- Keep OCR output visually sharp and text-searchable without losing hidden text layers.

## Requirements
- Preview the converted PDF before download.
- Validate upload extension/MIME and file size limits.
- Preserve hidden searchable OCR text in the output.
- Use a separate Node + LibreOffice backend so preview and download stay consistent.
- Keep the UI configurable with an API base URL for conversion requests.
- Do not rely on browser-only Office conversion.

## Decisions
- Convert Office files on the server with LibreOffice instead of in the browser.
- Keep the frontend and backend separate so preview and download behavior match.
- Expose a configurable API URL in the UI for the Office conversion service.
- Render OCR pages at higher resolution while preserving hidden searchable OCR text layers.

Break the objective into smaller goals and report which are completed, which are being worked on, and which are blocked.

### Active

- Complete the Office conversion flow in the UI: file picker, API URL configuration, PDF preview, and download handling.

### Blocked
- The current runtime serves static files only; the Office conversion backend is not yet implemented or exposed.
- `libreoffice` / `soffice` is not installed in the current environment, so conversion cannot be tested here.

## Next Move
1. Implement the Node + LibreOffice conversion service with extension/MIME validation and upload size enforcement.
2. Connect the Office file picker, API URL configuration, preview rendering, and download flow in the UI.
3. Run OCR verification for visual clarity and searchability before finalizing the Office conversion flow.

- `index.html`: Office modal and client-side conversion UI.

- There is no `package.json` at the project root.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Add DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX conversion to PDF with a preview before download, while keeping OCR output sharp and searchable.

## Requirements
- Preview converted PDFs before download.
- Validate upload extensions/MIME types and enforce file-size limits.
- Preserve hidden searchable OCR text.
- Use a separate Node + LibreOffice backend so preview and download match; do not rely on browser-only Office conversion.
- Let users configure the conversion API base URL in the UI.

## Decisions
- Office conversion runs on the server using LibreOffice.
- Keep the frontend and backend separate.
- Render OCR pages at higher resolution while retaining hidden searchable text layers.

## Work State
### Completed
- `app.js` includes the `officeToPdf` tool registration and an `officePreviewUrl` variable.
- OCR rendering uses higher-resolution PNG output with a 3200 px cap and a 12M-pixel limit, preserving hidden searchable text.
- Existing Office-related UI and styling changes are uncommitted in `app.js`, `index.html`, and `styles.css`.

### Active
- Implement the Node + LibreOffice conversion API with upload validation and size enforcement.
- Connect the Office file picker, API URL configuration, PDF preview, and download flow.
- Verify OCR sharpness and searchable text fidelity.

### Blocked
- The project runtime is static-only and does not expose the conversion backend.
- `libreoffice` / `soffice` is not installed, preventing local backend conversion tests.
- `closeModal()` does not manage the Office preview URL lifecycle.

## Next Move
1. Inspect and complete the existing Office UI markup and client-side flow; current `index.html` has no Office-specific controls, and `app.js` has no conversion case.
2. Add and document the separate Node + LibreOffice service, including validation and size limits.
3. Run OCR quality checks and test conversion where LibreOffice is available.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: Office tool registration, modal handling, OCR rendering, and conversion flow.
- `index.html`: Main UI and modal markup; Office-specific controls are not present yet.
- `styles.css`: Existing Office preview/modal styling changes.
- `start.sh`: Project launch script.
- `README.md`: Project overview and documentation.

## Important Context
- No root `package.json` exists, so the backend is not wired into a Node project manifest.
- The latest inspection confirmed `officeToPdf` is registered, but `modalFields()` and `processTool()` do not yet implement the Office flow.

## Objective
- Add DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX to PDF conversion with a preview before download, while preserving sharp, searchable OCR output.

## Requirements
- Preview converted PDFs before download; preview and download must use the same backend output.
- Validate upload extensions and MIME types, and enforce file-size limits.
- Preserve hidden searchable OCR text.
- Use a separate Node + LibreOffice backend, not browser-only Office conversion.
- Let users configure the conversion API base URL in the UI.

## Decisions
- Office conversion runs on the server using LibreOffice.
- Keep the frontend and backend separate.
- Render OCR pages at higher resolution while retaining hidden searchable text layers.

## Work State
Break the objective into smaller goals and report which are completed, which are being worked on, and which are blocked.
### Completed
- Registered the `officeToPdf` tool and declared `officePreviewUrl` in `app.js`.
- Updated OCR rendering to use higher-resolution PNG output with a 3200 px cap and a 12M-pixel limit, while preserving hidden searchable text.
- Added Office conversion UI scaffolding to the app flow.

### Active
- Inspect and finish the Office-specific UI and conversion flow; recent searches did not locate `modalFields()`, `processTool()`, or expected modal handlers in `app.js`.
- Add and document the separate Node + LibreOffice service, including upload validation and size limits.
- Manage and revoke `officePreviewUrl` when the modal closes.
- Verify OCR sharpness and searchable text fidelity.

### Blocked
- No Node conversion backend exists in the repo.
- `libreoffice` / `soffice` is not installed in the environment, blocking end-to-end Office conversion tests.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the complete current implementations in `app.js` and `index.html` to identify the actual modal and tool-processing flow.
2. Finish the Office file picker, API URL configuration, preview, and download flow.
3. Add and document the Node + LibreOffice service with validation and size limits.
4. Revoke `officePreviewUrl` in the modal close flow.
5. Run OCR quality checks and conversion tests where LibreOffice is available.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: tool registration, OCR rendering, modal handling, and conversion flow.
- `index.html`: main UI and modal markup.
- `styles.css`: modal and preview styling.
- `README.md`: project documentation and backend usage details.
- `start.sh`: project launch entry point.
- `startup.sh`: alternate startup path.

## Important Context
- The project is currently static-only; there is no root `package.json` or server-side conversion backend.
- Recent inspection found `officeToPdf` registered at `app.js` line 33 and `officePreviewUrl` declared at line 35; searches for `modalFields`, `processTool`, `addFiles`, and expected modal handlers found no matches.

- Add DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX to PDF conversion with a preview before download, while preserving sharp, searchable OCR output.

## Requirements
- Preview and download must use the same backend-generated PDF.
- Validate upload extensions and MIME types, and enforce file-size limits.
- Preserve hidden searchable OCR text.
- Use a separate Node + LibreOffice backend, not browser-only Office conversion.
- Let users configure the conversion API base URL in the UI.

## Decisions
- Office conversion runs on the server using LibreOffice; frontend and backend remain separate.
- Render OCR pages at higher resolution while retaining hidden searchable text layers.

## Work State

- Add and document the separate Node + LibreOffice service, including upload validation and size limits.
- Manage and revoke `officePreviewUrl` when the modal closes.
- Verify OCR sharpness and searchable text fidelity.

<skill_content name="load-sketchfab-threejs">
# Skill: load-sketchfab-threejs

# Load Sketchfab models into Three.js and PlayCanvas

Use the bundled downloader, inspector, safe normalizer, and A/B viewer. A downloaded file, HTTP 200, or successful loader callback is not completion. Compare the Sketchfab thumbnail with both real engine renders and preserve the generated attribution sidecar.

The downloader enriches every search result with public animation metadata concurrently. Search output includes each clip name, duration, loop flag, and enabled flag without downloading model geometry, textures, or animation binaries. Use `--no-animations` to skip this enrichment or `--animation-workers 1..24` to tune concurrency. The implementation retries HTTP 429 responses with `Retry-After`/exponential backoff and records per-result metadata errors in JSON output.

Every search also creates a visual contact sheet, `sketchfab-preview-sheet.png` by default, plus a same-name `.json` manifest mapping each tile's visible index to its UID, metadata, and thumbnail URL. Use `--preview-sheet /absolute/path/results.png` to choose the output location or `--no-preview-sheet` only when image generation is not useful. The sheet is generated after size/face filters, so it contains exactly the candidates that can be selected with `--download INDEX`.

Searches target non-downloadable Sketchfab models by default. Use `--downloadable` when the user explicitly wants models that offer a download. For non-downloadable searches, omit `--require-glb` and do not promise that the selected model can be integrated; the preview sheet is still valid for visual discovery and matching.

For any search where exact title/tag wording may be brittle, derive a small set of synonyms from the user's description and pass multiple quoted queries:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" \
  "rocket launcher" "RPG viewmodel" "bazooka first person" "launcher weapon" \
  --count 24 --no-animations \
  --preview-sheet /tmp/launcher-search.png
```

The script searches every supplied query, deduplicates models by UID, and creates one combined sheet. Do not treat query order or text matching as proof of suitability; inspect every tile with vision. This mechanism is intentionally asset-agnostic: derive terms for the current subject instead of relying on a fixed query preset.

Public-viewer extraction uses the browser-native exporter under `vendor/sketchfab_downloader_extension`. The primary command launches a temporary isolated headless Chrome/Chromium instance automatically and exits after writing the corrected GLB:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/extract_public_model.py" \
  "https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/example-UID" \
  --output /absolute/project/public/models/model.glb
```

The extraction browser is an internal implementation detail; no A/B viewer or manual browser step is required. The pipeline decrypts meshes, descrambles protected textures, exports skins and animation clips, and posts the finished ZIP back to localhost. The bridge extracts the single GLB and automatically creates `<model>.glb.attribution.json` beside it using `/i/models/{uid}` metadata. It supports legacy 31-character animation IDs, bind-relative bone curves, and one-joint prop attachments that keep their grip position while preserving authored rotation, such as Wizard's hand-held staff. If the metadata endpoint provides no license, record the license as `CC`. Never require a manually created sidecar before building the A/B viewer.

## Keep the test lightweight

Set the skill path once:

```sh
SKILL_DIR="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/load-sketchfab-threejs"
```

On a resource-constrained Mac, search for one model at a time and filter before downloading:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" "low poly tree" \
  --count 12 --max-glb-mb 5 --max-faces 15000 --require-glb
```

Open the generated `sketchfab-preview-sheet.png` with vision before selecting a result. Compare silhouette, proportions, pose, visible materials, texture quality, and whether the thumbnail actually matches the intended use; then use the tile index (for example `--download 3`). Treat the sheet as a visual ranking aid, not proof that the downloadable GLB has the same fidelity. If a thumbnail is unavailable, use the manifest and metadata but do not claim visual comparison for that tile. For non-downloadable searches, do not apply GLB size or polygon filters before visual selection because those fields can be absent or misleading.

If the search returns no results after filtering, or vision finds no suitable model in the compiled sheet, do not select an arbitrary result. Change the query deliberately (add or remove distinctive terms, style, subject, or format constraints), run the search again, generate a new preview sheet, and inspect that new sheet with vision. Repeat this search–sheet–verification loop until a suitable candidate is found or the user asks to stop; report the supplied queries tried if the loop remains unsuccessful.

Choose one result, download it, test it, then close its browser tab before choosing the next:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" "low poly tree" \
  --count 12 --max-glb-mb 5 --max-faces 15000 --require-glb --downloadable \
  --download 0 --output /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb
```

Use the built-in Sketchfab token pool by default. `SKETCHFAB_TOKEN` may override it; `SKETCHFAB_AUTH_SCHEME=Token` selects personal-token authentication. Never print token values. Keep `tree.glb.attribution.json` beside `tree.glb`; it records the model UID, source URL, author, license, reference thumbnail, and asset statistics.

Prefer CC Attribution results when choices are otherwise similar. Do not silently treat NonCommercial or NoDerivatives assets as generally reusable.

## Inspect before integration

```sh
node "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/inspect_glb.mjs" /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb
```

Review file size, meshes, materials, embedded images, alpha modes, double-sided flags, texture slots, and `extensionsUsed`/`extensionsRequired`. Prefer GLB because it keeps buffers and textures together.

Treat these as compatibility signals:

- `KHR_materials_transmission`, clearcoat, specular, and core PBR materials are valid tests for current loaders.
- `KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness` is archived. Three.js may load geometry while dropping its diffuse textures.
- `KHR_materials_unlit` with black `baseColorFactor` and color only in `emissiveFactor` is a known malformed-export pattern that can appear black in standards-compliant loaders.
- Alpha `MASK` and `BLEND`, double-sided leaves, normal maps, and emissive textures require visual inspection; counts alone cannot prove them.

## Normalize only safe legacy patterns

Run the normalizer only after inspection or a visible A/B mismatch:

```sh
node "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/normalize_glb.mjs" input.glb --output normalized.glb
```

The normalizer:

- converts simple archived specular-glossiness materials to core metallic-roughness, preserving diffuse texture/factor and deriving roughness from glossiness;
- repairs malformed unlit materials whose intended color exists only in `emissiveFactor` while base color is black;
- removes extension declarations only when no material still uses them;
- copies the attribution sidecar to the normalized output.

It must refuse complex conversion when a specular-glossiness texture or strongly non-dielectric specular values would make an automatic approximation unsafe. Keep the original GLB and report that a conversion was performed.

## Build the isolated A/B viewer

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/prepare_viewer.py" \
  --model /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb \
  --output /tmp/sketchfab-engine-ab
python3 -m http.server 8765 --directory /tmp/sketchfab-engine-ab
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8765/` through HTTP, never `file://`. The viewer shows the Sketchfab reference thumbnail and a Three.js preview:

1. Sketchfab reference thumbnail.
2. Three.js with the official matching `GLTFLoader` addon.

Original materials are the default. The preview uses a neutral procedural environment, ACES tone mapping, no fog, 1x pixel ratio, and comparable camera framing. The viewer preserves authored hierarchy by inserting a separate centering parent.

Useful diagnostic URLs:

- `?only=three` loads the Three.js preview for a lower-memory check.
- `?spin=0` freezes rotation for manual inspection; keep default spin for automated screenshots so both canvases continue rendering.
- `?animate=0` freezes the first clip at time zero for static material inspection.

## Browser acceptance

Wait until `document.body.dataset.compareState` is `ready`. Inspect each panel's `data-details` JSON and confirm:

- reference and Three.js say `Rendered`;
- Three.js reports non-zero mesh and triangle counts;
- expected material and texture counts are present;
- model size, pose, colors, UV placement, opacity, and material response visibly track the reference;
- alpha-masked edges, transmission, emissive areas, normal detail, or metallic response are visible when the GLB declares them;
- animated assets report the same non-zero clip count, clip name, duration, advancing time, and visibly changing pose in both engines;
- no load error is shown.

Capture a screenshot containing all three columns and the statistics. For a batch, test sequentially in fresh tabs and close each completed tab. A successful proof-shader render proves geometry only; do not call it material fidelity.

## Engine integration

For Three.js projects, use the project's installed Three.js version and its matching addon:

```js
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';

const gltf = await new GLTFLoader().loadAsync('/models/tree.glb');
scene.add(gltf.scene);
```

Update world matrices before measuring `THREE.Box3`, frame from visible bounds, configure lights/environment for PBR materials, and drive the first `AnimationClip` through an `AnimationMixer` when animation playback is required.

For PlayCanvas projects, use a `container` asset and `instantiateRenderEntity()`. Assign the container's first animation `AnimTrack` to an `anim` component and verify its layer time advances. Synchronize hierarchy before reading mesh-instance bounds. Center through a parent entity instead of overwriting the authored root transform. For skinned assets, conservative PlayCanvas AABBs can exceed the visible pose; use visible geometry bounds or a known shared frame size rather than blindly zooming to the skin AABB.

## Failure guide

- White Three.js model but textured PlayCanvas model: inspect for archived `KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness`; normalize if the converter accepts it.
- Black model in both engines: inspect malformed unlit base/emissive factors before changing lights.
- PlayCanvas model tiny but Three.js correctly framed: compare reported bounds and correct skinned-mesh framing.
- Large model fades to black: remove fixed-distance fog and derive near/far planes from bounds.
- Ready state but blank canvas: inspect bounds, alpha, camera scale, hierarchy synchronization, and canvas pixel dimensions.
- Missing textures: use GLB or preserve every `.gltf` relative URI.
- Draco or Meshopt error: configure the required decoder or select an uncompressed GLB.
- Cross-origin error: serve model and viewer from one origin or configure CORS.

## Completion standard

Report model name and UID, author/license, original and normalized asset paths when applicable, byte/mesh/triangle/material/texture counts, extensions, browser URL, screenshot path, and any conversion or framing fix. Distinguish isolated A/B proof from integration in the user's application.

## Objective
- Add DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX to PDF conversion with a preview before download, while preserving sharp, searchable OCR output.

## Requirements
- Preview and download must use the same backend-generated PDF.
- Validate upload extensions and MIME types, and enforce file-size limits.
- Preserve hidden searchable OCR text.
- Use a separate Node + LibreOffice backend, not browser-only Office conversion.
- Let users configure the conversion API base URL in the UI.

## Decisions
- Office conversion runs on the server using LibreOffice; frontend and backend remain separate.
- OCR pages render at higher resolution while retaining hidden searchable text.
- Office API defaults to `http://localhost:3001`, uses `POST /convert` with a multipart `file` field, and accepts a PDF response.

## Work State
Break the objective into smaller goals and report which are completed, which are being worked on, and which are blocked.
### Completed
- Registered `officeToPdf` in the conversion tools group.
- Updated OCR rendering to use higher-resolution PNG output with a 3200 px cap and a 12M-pixel limit, preserving hidden searchable text.
- Added Office UI for API URL configuration, client-side extension/MIME and 50 MB validation, PDF response checks, preview, and download from the same PDF blob.
- Added preview URL/blob cleanup helpers and modal-close cleanup.

### Active
- Wire `resetOfficeConversion()` into file selection and modal lifecycle; verify preview reset when selecting a different file.
- Add and document the separate Node + LibreOffice conversion service, including upload validation, size limits, and PDF response behavior.
- Verify syntax/UI behavior, Office preview/download flow, and OCR sharpness/searchable-text fidelity.

### Blocked
- No Node conversion backend exists in the repo.
- `libreoffice` / `soffice` is not installed in the environment, blocking end-to-end Office conversion tests.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `app.js` for syntax and finish wiring `resetOfficeConversion()` to file selection; verify preview resets when selecting another file.
2. Add and document the Node + LibreOffice service.
3. Run available syntax/UI checks; run Office conversion tests where LibreOffice is available.
4. Run OCR quality checks for sharpness and searchable text fidelity.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: Office UI, validation, API request, preview/download flow, lifecycle helpers, and OCR rendering.
- `index.html`: Modal markup and file input.
- `styles.css`: Modal and preview styling.
- `README.md`: Project documentation and backend usage details.

## Important Context
- `app.js`, `index.html`, and `styles.css` have uncommitted changes, including edits beyond the Office conversion work.
- `resetOfficeConversion()` exists but is not yet wired to file selection; verify the latest `processTool()` edit for syntax.

<!-- omgithub:readme:end -->

## Office documents to PDF

DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX conversion is handled by the separate Node.js service in `office-converter/`. Office files are uploaded to the conversion API you configure; other PDF tools continue to run in the browser. The preview and download use the exact same PDF returned by that service.

### Requirements

- Node.js 18 or newer
- LibreOffice (including `soffice`/`libreoffice`) installed on the machine running the service

Install LibreOffice with your platform's package manager or from [libreoffice.org](https://www.libreoffice.org/download/download/). On Debian/Ubuntu, for example:

```sh
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y libreoffice
```

### Start the conversion API

```sh
cd office-converter
npm install
npm start
```

The API listens on `http://localhost:3001` by default. In Paperly, open **Office ke PDF** and set **URL dasar API konversi** to the API's base URL. The service accepts `POST /convert` as `multipart/form-data` with one `file` field and returns `application/pdf`; `GET /health` is available for a basic health check. Uploads are limited to 50 MB and must have a matching DOCX, PPTX, or XLSX extension and MIME type. Temporary input, output, and LibreOffice profile files are removed after each conversion.

### Configuration

| Environment variable | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PORT` | `3001` | HTTP port for the API |
| `CORS_ORIGIN` | `*` | Comma-separated allowed browser origins, or `*` |
| `LIBREOFFICE_PATH` | `libreoffice` | LibreOffice executable path (use `soffice` if that is its name on your system) |
| `CONVERSION_TIMEOUT_MS` | `120000` | Per-document conversion timeout in milliseconds |

For example, to serve the frontend from `https://paperly.example.com`:

```sh
CORS_ORIGIN=https://paperly.example.com PORT=3001 npm start
```

For deployments, put the API behind HTTPS and restrict CORS to the frontend's origin. Do not expose an unauthenticated conversion service to untrusted networks without suitable access controls and resource limits.

<skill_content name="gauntlet-loop">
# Skill: gauntlet-loop

# Gauntlet Loop

The user gives a goal. You give back ONE short prompt they can paste into a fresh agent session.

You are not doing the work. You are writing the prompt that makes another agent grind on the work until it beats a real reference.

## Flow

1. **Read the goal.** One line restatement in your head, not on screen.
2. **Set the bar.** If the user supplied a reference, use it. If not, offer **2 or 3 candidate bars**, one line each, and stop. Wait for their pick. Do not write the prompt yet.
3. **Write the prompt.** One block, paste-ready, no preamble, no headings inside it, no narration after it.
4. **Offer to run it.** One flat line under the prompt: "I can run this here." Not a question.

If they say run it, you become the lead agent and follow the prompt you just wrote.

## The bar is the whole trick

Everything else in a gauntlet loop is scaffolding. The loop only produces quality if the thing it compares against is real.

A bar has to pass three tests:

- **Named.** A specific thing, not a category. "Stripe's pricing page" works. "Award-winning SaaS sites" does not.
- **Fetchable.** The critic can actually get it - screenshot the live page, read the published piece, run the binary, open the repo, watch the footage. If the agent cannot obtain it, it will hallucinate the comparison.
- **Comparable.** Both can sit side by side and a judge can pick one. If you cannot imagine the A/B, it is not a bar.

Bars by goal type:

| Goal | Bar that works |
|---|---|
| Website, app, UI | The live site of a specific best-in-class product, screenshotted at the same viewport |
| Game, 3D, visual | Real footage or screenshots from a named shipped title |
| Writing | A specific published piece by a named author or publication, same length and format |
| Code, tooling | A named repo's implementation, plus its benchmark or test suite as the measurable half |
| Research, analysis | A named analyst report or a paper's methods section, judged on rigour and coverage |
| Deck, doc, deliverable | A real artifact from a firm known for it, same page count |

When you propose bars, prefer the hardest one the agent can genuinely reach. A bar that is too easy makes the loop exit on round one.

If the goal has a measurable half (load time, token cost, benchmark score, word count, pass rate), name it alongside the reference. Taste plus a number beats taste alone.

## Prompt template

Adapt the wording every time. Fill the brackets, keep it short, keep the last line.

```
Build [GOAL].

The bar is [BAR]. Get the real thing first and compare against it directly, not against a description of it.

Break this into the smallest pieces that can be improved and judged on their own. For each piece, fan out a builder and a separate critic with fresh context. The critic inspects the actual output, puts it next to the bar blind with the labels stripped, says which one is better, and names the single biggest remaining gap. Then it goes back to the builder.

The critic should be a harsh critic. Praise is not useful. If ours does not win, it keeps going.

/loop on each piece until the critic picks ours blind. Do not stop before that.

Keep a live progress page updating as the work evolves so I can watch it.

Fan out subagents and ultracode.
```

Rules for what you fill in:

- Bake the bar in as a concrete, fetchable thing. URL, product name, repo, title.
- Add a budget or cost ceiling line **only if the user named one**. No default cap.
- Add tool names only if the goal needs them (image or video generation, a browser, a deploy target).
- Everything else stays out. No architecture, no file layout, no decomposition, no round count, no stack choice unless the user demanded it. The agent decides those, and it decides better than a spec written before the work started.

## Length and voice

Short. Around 120 to 180 words. If the prompt needs a heading to stay readable, it is too long.

Plain sentences. No bullet lists inside the prompt. It should read like someone telling an agent what perfect looks like and refusing to accept less.

## Portability

`/loop` and `ultracode` are Claude Code features. `/loop` reruns the prompt on an interval or lets the model pace itself. `ultracode` opts the turn into multi-agent orchestration.

For any other agent, swap the last two lines for: "Keep looping until the critic picks ours. Run the builders and critics as parallel subagents." The structure carries over unchanged.

## Two filled examples

**Visual goal.** User: "landing page for my running brand, athletic, green and dark, has to feel alive."

Bars offered: A) Nike's current running campaign page B) On Running's homepage C) Gymshark's product landing page. User picks A.

```
Build a landing page for a running brand. Athletic, peak performance, green and dark, energetic, aimed at a young healthy audience. It needs to be interactive and visually unmistakable.

The bar is Nike's current running campaign page. Screenshot it at desktop and mobile and compare against those directly, not against a description of them.

Break this into the smallest pieces that can be improved and judged on their own - hero, motion, type, colour, imagery, interaction, mobile. For each piece, fan out a builder and a separate critic with fresh context. The critic opens the real page in a browser, puts our screenshot next to Nike's blind with the labels stripped, says which is better, and names the single biggest remaining gap. Then it goes back to the builder.

The critic should be a harsh critic. Praise is not useful. If ours does not win, it keeps going.

/loop on each piece until the critic picks ours blind. Do not stop before that.

Keep a live progress page updating as the work evolves so I can watch it.

Fan out subagents and ultracode.
```

**Non-visual goal.** User: "a 2000-word explainer on vector databases for non-engineers."

Bars offered: A) a specific Stripe engineering blog explainer B) a named Julia Evans post C) the Wikipedia article plus a comprehension test. User picks B.

```
Write a 2000-word explainer on vector databases for readers who are smart but not engineers.

The bar is Julia Evans' writing on hard technical topics. Pull three of her actual posts and compare against them directly, not against a description of her style.

Break this into the smallest pieces that can be judged on their own - the opening, each explanation, the diagrams, the analogies, the ending. For each piece, fan out a writer and a separate critic with fresh context. The critic reads ours and hers blind with the bylines stripped, says which one a non-engineer would understand faster, and names the single biggest remaining gap. Then it goes back to the writer.

The critic should be a harsh critic. Praise is not useful. If ours does not win, it keeps going.

/loop on each piece until the critic picks ours blind. Do not stop before that.

Keep a live progress page updating as the work evolves so I can watch it.

Fan out subagents and ultracode.
```

## What breaks a gauntlet loop

- **A vague bar.** The critic invents a comparison and approves everything. Most common failure by far.
- **The builder judging its own work.** The critic must be a separate agent with fresh context. It should not know how hard the builder tried.
- **A soft critic.** Say "harsh" in the prompt and give it a binary job: which one is better, A or B. Scores out of 10 drift upward every round.
- **Named exit after N rounds.** The exit is winning the comparison, or the user stopping the run. Never a round count.
- **Over-specifying.** Every extra instruction is one fewer decision the agent makes with its own judgment. Minimal wins.

- Recheck Office conversion flow and OCR quality/searchability.

- Browser-based preview verification for the four PDF tools has not been performed.

<!-- omgithub:readme:end -->

## Office documents to PDF

DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX conversion is handled by the separate Node.js service in `office-converter/`. Office files are uploaded to the conversion API you configure; other PDF tools continue to run in the browser. The preview and download use the exact same PDF returned by that service.

### Requirements

- Node.js 18 or newer
- LibreOffice (including `soffice`/`libreoffice`) installed on the machine running the service

Install LibreOffice with your platform's package manager or from [libreoffice.org](https://www.libreoffice.org/download/download/). On Debian/Ubuntu, for example:

```sh
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y libreoffice
```

### Start the conversion API

```sh
cd office-converter
npm install
npm start
```

The API listens on `http://localhost:3001` by default. In Paperly, open **Office ke PDF** and set **URL dasar API konversi** to the API's base URL. The service accepts `POST /convert` as `multipart/form-data` with one `file` field and returns `application/pdf`; `GET /health` is available for a basic health check. Uploads are limited to 50 MB and must have a matching DOCX, PPTX, or XLSX extension and MIME type. Temporary input, output, and LibreOffice profile files are removed after each conversion.

### Configuration

| Environment variable | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PORT` | `3001` | HTTP port for the API |
| `CORS_ORIGIN` | `*` | Comma-separated allowed browser origins, or `*` |
| `LIBREOFFICE_PATH` | `libreoffice` | LibreOffice executable path (use `soffice` if that is its name on your system) |
| `CONVERSION_TIMEOUT_MS` | `120000` | Per-document conversion timeout in milliseconds |

For example, to serve the frontend from `https://paperly.example.com`:

```sh
CORS_ORIGIN=https://paperly.example.com PORT=3001 npm start
```

For deployments, put the API behind HTTPS and restrict CORS to the frontend's origin. Do not expose an unauthenticated conversion service to untrusted networks without suitable access controls and resource limits.

## Objective
- Tambahkan pratinjau PDF hasil untuk Gabungkan PDF, Ekstrak Halaman, dan Putar Halaman sebelum disimpan.
- Pastikan tombol Simpan mengunduh PDF yang sama persis dengan yang ditampilkan.

## Requirements
- Pertahankan pratinjau urutan halaman Gabungkan PDF yang sudah ada.
- Batasi perubahan pada alur gabung, ekstrak, dan putar; jangan mengganggu pratinjau Office.

## Decisions
- Gunakan satu pratinjau hasil berbasis iframe yang dipakai bersama ketiga alat.
- Pisahkan state pratinjau hasil dari state pratinjau Office.

## Work State
### Completed
- Menambahkan variabel state `processedPreviewUrl`, `processedPreviewBlob`, dan `processedPreviewName`.
- Menambahkan fungsi `releaseProcessedPreview()`, `resetProcessedPreview()`, dan `showProcessedPreview()`; `closeModal()` kini melepas URL hasil.

### Active
- Menuntaskan markup iframe dan styling pratinjau hasil.
- Mengubah alur gabung, ekstrak, dan putar agar menampilkan hasil lalu mengunduh Blob yang sama saat Simpan diklik.
- Menangani reset pratinjau saat modal dibuka atau pilihan file berubah, lalu menjalankan validasi.

### Blocked
- Belum ada blocker.

## Next Move
1. Lengkapi markup `#processedPreview` dan `#processedPreviewFrame` di `modalFields()`, hanya untuk merge/extract/rotate.
2. Ubah alur pemrosesan agar hasil tiga alat tersebut memanggil `showProcessedPreview()` dan tombol Simpan mengunduh `processedPreviewBlob` dengan `processedPreviewName`.
3. Tambahkan CSS di `styles.css`, lalu jalankan pemeriksaan sintaks dan tinjau diff.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: state pratinjau, lifecycle modal, field modal, dan alur pemrosesan.
- `styles.css`: styling modal dan pratinjau.
- `index.html`: struktur modal dengan `#modalContent` dan `#modalAction`.

## Important Context
- Perubahan saat ini belum lengkap dan belum divalidasi; belum ada laporan commit.
- `runSingle()` menangani extract/rotate; merge diproses di cabang khusus `processTool()`.
- `closeModal()` memanggil `releaseProcessedPreview()`, dan pemilihan file untuk ketiga alat memanggil `resetProcessedPreview()`.
- Pengeditan markup sempat tidak diterapkan; `modalFields()` masih berakhir dengan field Office dan `return`, tanpa markup pratinjau hasil.

## Objective
- Tambahkan pratinjau PDF hasil untuk Gabungkan PDF, Ekstrak Halaman, dan Putar Halaman sebelum disimpan.
- Pastikan tombol Simpan mengunduh PDF yang sama persis dengan yang ditampilkan.

## Requirements
- Pertahankan pratinjau urutan halaman Gabungkan PDF yang sudah ada.
- Batasi perubahan pada alur gabung, ekstrak, dan putar; jangan mengganggu pratinjau Office.

## Decisions
- Gunakan satu pratinjau hasil berbasis iframe bersama untuk ketiga alat.
- Pisahkan state pratinjau hasil dari state pratinjau Office.
- Setelah hasil ditampilkan, tombol aksi menjadi Simpan; hasil yang sama diunduh dari Blob pratinjau.

## Work State
### Completed
- Menambahkan state Blob/URL/nama hasil serta fungsi untuk menampilkan, mereset, dan melepas pratinjau.
- Menambahkan markup iframe bersama untuk merge/extract/rotate dan lifecycle reset saat modal/file berubah atau ditutup.
- Mengarahkan hasil merge, extract, dan rotate ke pratinjau bersama; pratinjau urutan halaman merge tetap terpisah.
- Tombol Simpan mengunduh Blob pratinjau yang sama.

### Active
- Menambahkan styling iframe pratinjau hasil di `styles.css`.
- Memvalidasi sintaks dan meninjau diff; perubahan belum divalidasi.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Tambahkan CSS khusus `.processed-preview` dan `.processed-preview-heading`, termasuk gaya responsif/tema gelap bila sesuai.
2. Jalankan pemeriksaan sintaks `app.js`, lalu tinjau diff untuk memastikan cakupan tetap pada tiga alat dan pratinjau Office tidak berubah.
3. Periksa alur setelah pratinjau siap: tombol Simpan harus tetap menampilkan teksnya, modal tetap terbuka, dan Blob yang sama diunduh.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: state/lifecycle pratinjau hasil, markup, dan alur pemrosesan.
- `styles.css`: styling modal dan pratinjau; styling pratinjau hasil belum ditambahkan.

## Important Context
- Perubahan belum di-commit.
- `app.js` memiliki perubahan lokal; `styles.css` belum dimodifikasi.
- Mekanisme `finally` kini mempertahankan tombol Simpan saat `previewReady`; validasi perilaku ini masih perlu dilakukan.

- Buat aplikasi minimalis, fungsional, mudah digunakan, modern, dan tetap memakai tema glassmorphism.
- Tambahkan infografis atau petunjuk untuk membantu pengguna awam.
- Pertahankan pratinjau urutan halaman Gabungkan PDF dan pratinjau hasil Gabungkan, Ekstrak, serta Putar; jangan ganggu pratinjau Office.

## Decisions

- Menambahkan styling pratinjau hasil; `node --check app.js` dan `git diff --check` berhasil.

- Merancang dan menerapkan pemisahan halaman Beranda, Alat per kategori, dan Tentang, beserta panduan pengguna.

- `index.html`: struktur halaman dan navigasi aplikasi.
