## Objective
- Perbarui UI/UX Paperly dengan halaman Beranda, Alat yang dikelompokkan berdasarkan fungsi, dan Tentang Pengembang, sambil mempertahankan alur alat PDF yang sudah ada.

## Requirements
- Aplikasi minimalis, fungsional, mudah digunakan, modern, dan tetap memakai tema glassmorphism.
- Tambahkan infografis atau petunjuk untuk membantu pengguna awam.
- Pertahankan pratinjau urutan halaman Gabungkan PDF dan pratinjau hasil Gabungkan, Ekstrak, serta Putar; jangan ganggu pratinjau Office.

## Decisions
- Navigasi utama memakai halaman Beranda, Alat per kategori, dan Tentang.
- Pratinjau hasil PDF memakai satu iframe bersama; tombol Simpan mengunduh Blob yang sama dengan yang dipratinjau.

## Work State
### Completed
- Menambahkan pratinjau hasil dan alur Simpan untuk Gabungkan, Ekstrak, dan Putar.
- Pemeriksaan `node --check app.js` dan `git diff --check` berhasil sebelum pekerjaan navigasi terbaru.

### Active
- Merancang dan menerapkan pemisahan halaman Beranda, Alat per kategori, dan Tentang beserta panduan pengguna.
- Struktur HTML dan navigasi yang ada telah mulai diperiksa; implementasi terbaru belum tercatat.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Periksa struktur navigasi dan markup di `index.html`, `app.js`, dan `styles.css`.
2. Terapkan halaman dan navigasi baru tanpa merusak alur modal serta pratinjau yang ada.
3. Jalankan pemeriksaan dan, jika tersedia, tinjau tampilan melalui browser.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: struktur halaman dan navigasi aplikasi.
- `app.js`: interaksi navigasi, modal, dan alur pemrosesan PDF.
- `styles.css`: tema glassmorphism dan tata letak responsif.

## Important Context
- Perubahan pratinjau PDF di `app.js` dan `styles.css` belum di-commit.
- Status terakhir menunjukkan `app.js` dan `styles.css` berubah; `git diff --check` tidak melaporkan masalah.
- `app.js` memiliki `toolGroups`, `renderTools()`, dan `openTool()`; `renderTools()` saat ini membuat grup alat serta membuka modal alat.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Perbarui UI/UX Paperly dengan halaman Beranda, Alat per kategori, dan Tentang Pengembang, sambil mempertahankan alur alat PDF yang sudah ada.
- Buat aplikasi minimalis, modern, mudah digunakan, bertema glassmorphism, dengan panduan untuk pengguna awam.

## Requirements
- Navigasi utama memakai Beranda, Alat per kategori, dan Tentang; hash seperti `#home` harus menampilkan halaman yang sesuai, bukan sekadar menggulir.
- Pertahankan pratinjau urutan halaman Gabungkan PDF serta pratinjau hasil Gabungkan, Ekstrak, dan Putar.
- Jangan ganggu pratinjau Office.
- Gunakan konten section yang ada agar modal dan pemrosesan alat tidak perlu diubah.

## Decisions
- Pratinjau hasil PDF memakai satu iframe bersama; tombol Simpan mengunduh Blob yang sama dengan yang dipratinjau.
- Gunakan section yang sudah ada sebagai konten per halaman, tanpa mengubah pemrosesan PDF/Office.

## Work State
### Completed
- Pratinjau hasil dan alur Simpan untuk Gabungkan, Ekstrak, dan Putar sudah ditambahkan.
- Markup navigasi di `index.html` dan bagian `toolGroups`, `renderTools()`, `openTool()` di `app.js` sudah ditinjau.

### Active
- Implementasikan tampilan Beranda, Alat per kategori, dan Tentang serta perilaku navigasi hash di `index.html` dan `app.js`.
- Ubah navigasi sidebar menjadi tiga halaman utama dan tambahkan panduan singkat untuk pengguna awam.
- Jalankan pemeriksaan kode dan tinjau tampilan; pastikan pratinjau Office tidak berubah.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Periksa markup navigasi lengkap di `index.html` dan interaksi navigasi di `app.js`.
2. Implementasikan tampilan halaman berdasarkan hash serta panduan pengguna.
3. Jalankan pemeriksaan sintaks dan diff; tinjau tampilan, terutama pratinjau Office.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: struktur halaman, navigasi, dan hero Beranda.
- `app.js`: kelompok alat, navigasi, modal, serta pemrosesan PDF/Office.
- `styles.css`: tema glassmorphism dan tata letak responsif.

## Important Context
- Perubahan pratinjau PDF di `app.js` dan `styles.css` belum di-commit.
- `index.html` sudah memiliki hero Beranda dan tautan brand `#home`; mekanisme tampilan halaman hash belum ditemukan.
- HTML masih menampilkan semua section sekaligus dan memiliki menu `Terakhir dipakai`, yang belum sesuai dengan tiga halaman utama.
- `node --check app.js` dan `git diff --check` berhasil sebelum pekerjaan navigasi.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Perbarui UI/UX Paperly dengan halaman Beranda, Alat per kategori, dan Tentang Pengembang, mempertahankan alur alat PDF/Office.
- Pengguna meminta penyuntingan langsung dan commit ke GitHub; perubahan belum di-commit.

## Requirements
- Navigasi hash `#home`, `#tools`, dan `#about` menampilkan halaman masing-masing; hapus menu “Terakhir dipakai”.
- Gunakan label “Alat per kategori” dan “Tentang Pengembang”.
- Tambahkan panduan singkat untuk pengguna awam.
- Pertahankan pratinjau urutan halaman Gabungkan PDF serta pratinjau hasil Gabungkan, Ekstrak, dan Putar.
- Jangan ganggu pratinjau Office atau mengubah pemrosesan PDF/Office.

## Decisions
- Pratinjau hasil PDF memakai satu iframe bersama; tombol Simpan mengunduh Blob yang sama dengan yang dipratinjau.
- Gunakan konten section dan modal yang ada, dengan perubahan pada tampilan halaman dan navigasi.

## Work State
### Completed
- Pratinjau hasil dan alur Simpan untuk Gabungkan, Ekstrak, dan Putar telah ditambahkan pada perubahan lokal.
- Menu “Terakhir dipakai” dihapus dan label navigasi diganti.
- Markup mulai dibungkus dalam container `homePage`, `toolsPage`, dan `aboutPage`.
- CSS awal untuk halaman hash dan kartu panduan ditambahkan.
- Tombol hero “Jelajahi alat” mulai diarahkan ke `#tools`.

### Active
- Selesaikan routing hash pada `app.js`, termasuk klik sidebar dan browser Back/Forward.
- Tambahkan konten panduan singkat di Beranda.
- Periksa dan rapikan struktur markup halaman yang baru dibungkus.
- Jalankan pemeriksaan sintaks/diff dan validasi pratinjau Office.
- Commit perubahan ke GitHub setelah pemeriksaan berhasil.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Lengkapi routing untuk `#home`, `#tools`, dan `#about`; perbarui handler navigasi sidebar.
2. Tambahkan panduan pengguna di Beranda dan pastikan section Tentang/Alat berada pada halaman yang tepat.
3. Jalankan `node --check app.js` dan `git diff --check`, tinjau perubahan, lalu buat commit.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: navigasi dan markup halaman Beranda, Alat, dan Tentang.
- `app.js`: routing hash, interaksi navigasi, modal, serta pemrosesan.
- `styles.css`: tema, tata letak, dan gaya responsif.

## Important Context
- Perubahan pratinjau PDF dan perubahan UI saat ini belum di-commit.
- `index.html` sudah menghapus item Terakhir dipakai, tetapi pembungkusan markup baru perlu diverifikasi.
- `app.js` masih memiliki handler navigasi lama yang menggulir ke section; routing hash belum lengkap.
- CSS kelas `.quick-guide` dan `.guide-card` sudah tersedia, tetapi konten panduannya belum ditambahkan.
- Pratinjau Office sebelumnya tidak diubah oleh perubahan UI terakhir.

## Objective
- Perbarui UI/UX Paperly dengan halaman Beranda, Alat per kategori, dan Tentang Pengembang, sambil mempertahankan alur alat PDF/Office.
- Perubahan diminta langsung di repository dan nantinya di-commit ke GitHub; belum di-commit.

## Requirements
- Navigasi hash `#home`, `#tools`, dan `#about` menampilkan halaman masing-masing; hapus menu “Terakhir dipakai”.
- Gunakan label “Alat per kategori” dan “Tentang Pengembang”.
- Tambahkan panduan singkat untuk pengguna awam.
- Pertahankan pratinjau urutan halaman Gabungkan PDF serta pratinjau hasil Gabungkan, Ekstrak, dan Putar.
- Jangan ganggu pratinjau Office atau mengubah pemrosesan PDF/Office.

## Decisions
- Pratinjau hasil PDF memakai satu iframe bersama; tombol Simpan mengunduh Blob yang sama dengan yang dipratinjau.
- Gunakan konten section dan modal yang ada, dengan perubahan pada tampilan halaman dan navigasi hash.

## Work State
### Completed
- Label navigasi diubah menjadi “Alat per kategori” dan “Tentang Pengembang”; item “Terakhir dipakai” dihapus dari `index.html`.
- Konten mulai dibungkus dalam `homePage`, `toolsPage`, dan `aboutPage`.
- CSS untuk tampilan halaman hash dan kartu panduan ditambahkan.
- Tombol hero “Jelajahi alat” diarahkan untuk mengubah hash ke `#tools`.
- Pratinjau hasil dan alur Simpan untuk Gabungkan, Ekstrak, dan Putar telah ditambahkan pada perubahan lokal.

### Active
- Lengkapi routing `#home`, `#tools`, dan `#about`, termasuk klik sidebar dan browser Back/Forward.
- Tambahkan isi panduan singkat di Beranda.
- Periksa penutupan dan penempatan markup halaman; pastikan konten Tentang berada di halaman yang benar.
- Jalankan pemeriksaan sintaks/diff dan validasi pratinjau Office.
- Commit perubahan setelah pemeriksaan berhasil.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Periksa struktur terbaru `index.html`, lalu lengkapi handler hash dan navigasi sidebar di `app.js`.

3. Jalankan `node --check app.js` dan `git diff --check`, tinjau perubahan, lalu buat commit.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: navigasi dan markup halaman Beranda, Alat, dan Tentang.
- `app.js`: routing hash, interaksi navigasi, pratinjau, dan pemrosesan.
- `styles.css`: tema, tata letak, dan gaya responsif.

- Semua perubahan masih lokal dan belum di-commit.

Diff looks right. One subtle bug: `showProcessedPreviewError` sets `s.doc=null` without destroying the doc. In error path after load, doc is null anyway; in render error with doc loaded, setting s.doc=null leaks the pdf document (not huge but should destroy). Also, `showProcessedPreviewError` may be called after a getDocument failure (doc null) or render failure (doc loaded). Better:

```
if(s.doc){try{s.doc.destroy()}catch(e){}s.doc=null}
```

And cancel renderTask? If render error, renderTask may be pending/rejected; set null. Add.

Also `updateProcessedPreviewChrome` after error: `!s.doc` disables zoom; pages 0 disables nav. Good.

Another subtle issue: calling `resetProcessedPreview` calls release which destroys doc and increments token, then `updateProcessedPreviewChrome('Memuat…')` sets status even though hidden. Fine.

Also in `renderProcessedPreviewPage`, when a `page.render` fails for a corrupt page, `s.renderTask` isn't reset and points to a rejected task; error function sets doc null but renderTask remains. Add cleanup in error function.

Let's patch showProcessedPreviewError:

```
function showProcessedPreviewError(message){const p=...,s=...;if(s.renderTask){try{s.renderTask.cancel()}catch(e){}s.renderTask=null}if(s.doc){try{s.doc.destroy()}catch(e){}s.doc=null}...
```

But wait: in `loadProcessedPreviewDocument` catch, s.doc may be null; fine. In render catch, destroying doc cancels further pages. Then user cannot navigate, as intended; Simpan still works.

Also `loadProcessedPreviewDocument` catch might be hit by a destroy-induced rejection? Token check handles.

## Objective
- Perbarui UI/UX Paperly dengan halaman Beranda, Alat per kategori, dan Tentang Pengembang tanpa mengganggu alur PDF/Office.
- Verifikasi dan pulihkan pratinjau hasil Ekstrak halaman dan Putar halaman, lalu uji aplikasi sebelum commit.

## Requirements
- Navigasi hash `#home`, `#tools`, dan `#about`; hapus menu “Terakhir dipakai”.
- Pertahankan pratinjau urutan halaman Gabungkan PDF serta pratinjau hasil Gabungkan, Ekstrak, dan Putar.
- Jangan mengubah pemrosesan PDF/Office di luar perbaikan yang diperlukan untuk pratinjau.

## Decisions
- Satu iframe dipakai bersama untuk pratinjau PDF; tombol Simpan mengunduh Blob yang sama.
- Ekstrak dan Putar dibatasi ke satu file agar hasilnya dapat dipratinjau sesuai deskripsi alat.
- Perubahan opsi rentang halaman atau rotasi menghapus pratinjau lama agar tidak menampilkan hasil kedaluwarsa.

## Work State
### Completed
- Halaman hash, navigasi sidebar, Back/Forward, panduan singkat, dan label navigasi diperbarui.
- Pratinjau Gabungkan, Ekstrak, dan Putar tersedia; pratinjau otomatis digulir ke tampilan.
- Uji browser mencakup navigasi desktop/mobile, 20 alat, Ekstrak, Putar, Gabungkan, beberapa alat PDF, dan preview Office dengan API mock.
- `node --check app.js` dan `git diff --check` lolos; tidak ditemukan error console.
- Perubahan di-commit dan di-push ke branch `opencode/44186349423`.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Jika perubahan disetujui, merge PR ke `main`: https://github.com/Hattaakim/PDF-Tools-Ai-Project/pull/new/opencode/44186349423

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: routing hash, pemrosesan, dan pratinjau PDF.
- `index.html`: navigasi dan markup halaman.
- `styles.css`: tampilan halaman dan responsif.

## Important Context
- Commit: `fb91170` — `Tambah halaman hash, panduan, dan pratinjau hasil PDF`.
- Perubahan berada di branch `opencode/44186349423`, bukan langsung di `main`.
- Pengujian hasil: Ekstrak menghasilkan PDF 2 halaman untuk rentang `1-2`; Putar menghasilkan rotasi 180° pada semua halaman; Gabungkan menghasilkan PDF 6 halaman.

The gold theme looks decent but still has mint tint in hero and privacy card, and the brand icon looks pale. Also the logo icon is a solid pale cream with gold strokes; we want gradient logo animation.

Let me refine:

Palette decisions:
- Primary gold: #c9971f / gradient #f5c945 → #c8860a → #a86a05? For elegance: gold gradient `#f7d774, #d9a520, #b0730a`.
- Keep mint only as subtle freshness? Better convert mint sections (hero gradient, privacy card, bottom banner) to warm cream/gold tints: #fdf6e4, #fbf3e0.
- Error rose stays.
- "new" tag green → gold? Maybe keep soft green for "Baru" badge is fine; but to theme gold, use amber.

Logo: 
- Make `.brand-icon` a gradient tile (linear-gradient 135deg gold shades) with white SVG icon; animated gradient shift (background-size 200%, animation 6s). White icon.
- brand-dot gradient text gold.
- Hover: rotate/scale with icon sparkle; click: add `logo-pop` class and sparkle ring via JS.
- Topbar brand dot already gradient? Check `.topbar-brand-dot` style.

Also favicon gold gradient.

Buttons:
- `.button-primary` gradient (gold) with hover shine sweep, lift, glow. Loading state animated gradient + spinner.
- `.button-quiet`, `.hero-cta`, `.theme-toggle`, `.preview-nav` hover transitions.
- Add ripple? Keep CSS-only.

Need to check the loading animation requirement: "tombol loading dengan animasi gradien yang dinamis". Add `.button-primary.loading` with animated gradient background (background-size 200%) plus a moving shimmer. Also the progress bar uses teal; change to gold tones.

Let's inspect styles around 240-330 and 520-600 for the logo/topbar, plus existing keyframes to avoid duplication.
Now check lines 160-240 (brand area enhancements) and 520-600 (card shimmer, hero shift).

Good context. The gold conversion is mostly done but with teal residue (#63b9a5, #3ea695, #7fe0c5, #3ec9a7, #85c9b0, #6cbf9a, #e2f4ec etc). Also #2a3d...? Let me systematically find remaining blue/teal hues overriding. Better: write a script to find colors with hue 160-260 (teal/blue/green-blue) and list. Then manually decide replacements. Green success may remain? User explicitly asks blue→gold; teal green is not blue but currently visually clashes with gold. A refined palette: gold primary + warm neutral + muted olive/sage for safety? Hmm. "kuning keemasan" means golden yellow. I'll convert teal accents into amber/gold; keep semantic green statuses (local status dot) perhaps to gold too. Error red stays.

Let me enumerate suspect colors.

We'll convert all these teal/green accents to gold/amber, but keep error colors. Also success/check green icons can become deep gold, which is acceptable.

Now decide the golden palette. Aim premium gold:

- Gold 600: #b07d0e (primary text/icon)
- Gold 500: #d4a017
- Gold 400: #e8bd4a
- Gold 300: #f2d488
- Gold tint: #fdf6e3 / #fbf2da
- Ink: #3a2f18 (warm dark brown)
- Muted: #75694f

Let me build a coherent token set and add to :root, then override key components. Avoid huge mechanical churn; targeted edits.

Objectives:
1. Theme: shift leftover teal to gold. Update hero, privacy card, banner, local status, nav active gradient, welcome heading gradient, brand icon gradient, progress bar, btn.
2. Logo: new gradient brand tile, animated gradient; brand name gradient animated subtly; hover/click animation via JS class.
3. Buttons: hover shine, lift, icon motion; loading animated gradient + spinner ring.
4. Ensure dark theme coherent gold.
5. Verify with screenshots light/dark/mobile; check animations via computed styles.
6. Increment cache versions; commit.

Step 2: Refine logo. Current `.brand-icon` gets gradient from line 558. I'll add explicit final overrides in a new "Golden theme + motion" section at end of styles.css so it wins (later cascade). That's cleaner than editing dozens.

## Objective
- Perbarui UI/UX Paperly dengan halaman Beranda, Alat per kategori, dan Tentang Pengembang tanpa mengganggu alur PDF/Office.
- Perbaiki pratinjau hasil PDF dan ubah tema aplikasi menjadi kuning keemasan dengan animasi logo dan tombol; commit dan push ke GitHub.

## Objective
- Perbarui UI/UX Paperly tanpa mengganggu alur PDF/Office, dan perbaiki progress bar yang macet setelah pemrosesan atau saat file baru dipilih.

## Requirements
- Gunakan navigasi hash `#home`, `#tools`, dan `#about`; hapus menu “Terakhir dipakai”.
- Pertahankan pratinjau urutan halaman Gabungkan PDF serta pratinjau hasil Gabungkan, Ekstrak, dan Putar.
- Jangan mengubah pemrosesan PDF/Office di luar perbaikan yang diperlukan.
- Pastikan tema dan animasi nyaman digunakan serta mengikuti `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Reset progress bar setelah pemrosesan selesai dan saat file baru dipilih.

## Decisions
- Satu iframe sebelumnya dipakai bersama untuk pratinjau PDF; pratinjau hasil kini dirender dengan PDF.js ke canvas.
- Ekstrak dan Putar dibatasi ke satu file agar hasilnya dapat dipratinjau.
- Perubahan rentang halaman atau rotasi menghapus pratinjau lama.

## Work State

### Completed
- Navigasi hash, sidebar, Back/Forward, panduan singkat, dan label navigasi diperbarui.
- Pratinjau PDF untuk Gabungkan, Ekstrak, dan Putar menggunakan PDF.js canvas dengan navigasi halaman dan zoom.
- Tema emas diterapkan di mode terang dan gelap; favicon dan `theme-color` diperbarui.
- Animasi logo dan tombol mengikuti pengaturan reduced motion.
- Uji browser mencakup navigasi desktop/mobile, 20 alat, pratinjau PDF, beberapa alat, dan preview Office dengan API mock.

README.md
skills

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.

There's an existing embedded table (`doc-sheet`) in the doc builder. Now we need a standalone "PDF Sheet" page like Excel. Need to decide architecture:

- Add a new tool entry with id maybe 'sheet' title 'PDF Sheet' in tools array, group tulis ids ['doc','edit','sheet'].
- openTool(id) intercept id==='sheet' → openSheetPage().
- New full-screen page `sheetPage` similar to doc-write, containing:
  - Topbar: back button (with confirm dialog?), title "PDF Sheet", status ("Draft" / "N sel"), actions: "Ekspor PDF".
  - Toolbar: formula bar (cell reference, fx input), formatting controls (bold, italic, underline?, alignment, borders, fill color, text color maybe), insert row/column, delete, number format, variable manager.
  - Spreadsheet grid: column headers A.. maybe 12-16 columns and 30-50 rows; row headers; editable cells.
  - Formula engine: supports =SUM(A1:A5), =AVERAGE, =MIN, =MAX, =COUNT, arithmetic + - * / ^ parentheses, cell refs, ranges, and named variables (define via "Variabel" panel: name = value or formula? "pengguna dapat mendefinisikan variabel" — variable definitions likely e.g. price = 15000, qty = 3, formula =price*qty). Implement variable definitions in a side panel/dialog with name and value/expression, and formulas can use names. Also maybe variable syntax `{{name}}`? Better: variables as names in formulas, e.g. `=harga*qty`. Need to be clear and avoid clashing with cell refs (A1). Define variable names letters/underscore.
  - Formula recursion: cell formula referencing other cells, variables, cycle detection.
  - Border application: apply border style to selected range (all/outer/bottom/top etc.) maybe buttons "Semua border", "Luar", "Dalam", "Hapus border". Simplify: border toggles on selected range: all borders, outer border, none. Could also apply bottom-only for headers. Let's implement border options in a dropdown/segmented: Semua, Luar, Bawah, Tanpa. Use CSS classes per cell (border-top/right/bottom/left) or inline style.
  - "fitur spreadsheet lainnya": bold/italic, alignment, text color/fill color, column/row add/remove, merge cells? That's complex but possible. Maybe not. Sorting? Could add number format (general, number, currency, percent), freeze header? Let's scope to robust set: selection ranges with drag/shift, keyboard navigation, copy/paste TSV, undo/redo, formatting, borders, insert/delete rows/columns, variable manager, formula bar, export PDF with page splitting, CSV export maybe. That's a lot but achievable.

Need to be careful about code size and time. Let's plan implement a solid mini spreadsheet.

Data model:
```js
const sheet = {
  cols: 12, rows: 30,
  cells: {}, // 'A1': {v:'raw', s:{bold,italic,align,color,bg,borders:{t,r,b,l,style}}}
  vars: {}, // name: 'expression or number'
  sel: {r:0,c:0}, anchor: {r:0,c:0}, // selection range
  editing: false,
  history: [], future: [],
  name: maybe 'Lembar 1'
}
```
Maybe multiple sheets? "halaman spreadsheet layaknya Microsoft Excel" could imply one sheet is fine. Could add sheet tabs? Not necessary; but maybe multiple sheets adds complexity in export and references. Skip with note.

Cell addressing: columns A..Z then AA... up to 12 columns. rows 1..40. Let's do 16 cols x 40 rows for decent canvas but grid virtualization not needed (640 cells). Export may produce multiple pages.

Formulas:
- Raw input starting with '=' is formula. Evaluate with a parser.

Implement tokenizer + recursive descent:
```
expr := term (('+'|'-') term)*
term := factor (('*'|'/') factor)*
factor := unary ('^' factor)?
unary := ('+'|'-') unary | primary
primary := number | string | name/func call | cellref | '(' expr ')' | range? (ranges only args)
```
Functions: SUM, AVERAGE/AVG, MIN, MAX, COUNT, COUNTA, ABS, ROUND, IF? IF adds comparisons. To keep formulas useful, support comparison operators and IF. Maybe also CONCAT? Let's implement:
- operators: + - * / ^ % (postfix percent optional), comparisons = <> < <= > >=, ampersand & for concatenation, parentheses.
- functions SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT, COUNTA, ROUND, ABS, SQRT, IF, AND, OR, NOT, CONCAT.
- ranges in function arguments, e.g. SUM(A1:A10). Range as value returns array.
- Named variables: names from `sheet.vars` map; variable value can be a formula or literal. Evaluate with cycle detection.
- Cell references like A1, $A$1 maybe. Support absolute $ optionally by stripping.

Excel-like coercion: numeric strings → number; empty → 0 in arithmetic; bool? keep simple.

Error display: #ERROR!, #CYCLE!, #DIV/0!, #NAME?.

Number formatting: per cell style `fmt`: 'auto'|'number'|'currency'|'percent'|'text'. Use Intl.NumberFormat('id-ID'). Currency IDR.

Selection:
- click cell selects; shift-click extends; mouse drag extends; arrow keys move; shift+arrow extends; Enter moves down, Tab right.
- double-click or typing starts editing; F2 edits.
- formula bar input edits current cell; Enter commit.
- Delete clears contents.
- Ctrl+C/V copy paste TSV; maybe use navigator.clipboard? Clipboard APIs may fail in http; use document execCommand? Simpler: internal clipboard plus paste event handling on grid. Copy: write TSV to clipboard via navigator.clipboard if available, fallback internal. Paste: handle `paste` event on page and parse TSV. Also Ctrl+C handler sets internal clipboard and tries clipboard.

Rendering:

Let me design data structures and functions: ```js /* ===== PDF Sheet: spreadsheet lokal dengan rumus dan variabel ===== */ const sheet={cols:16,rows:40,cells:{},vars:{},sel:{r:0,c:0},anchor:{r:0,c:0},editing:null,history:[],future:[],dragging:false,dirty:false,exported:false}; const SHEET_MAX_COLS=26, SHEET_MAX_ROWS=120; ``` Column names: ```js function sheetColName(c){let s='';c++;while(c>0){const m=(c-1)%26;s=String.fromCharCode(65+m)+s;c=Math.floor((c-1)/26)}return s} function sheetColIndex(name){let n=0;for(const ch of name.toUpperCase())n=n*26+(ch.charCodeAt(0)-64);return n-1} function sheetKey(r,c){return sheetColName(c)+(r+1)} function sheetParseKey(key){const m=/^([A-Z]+)(\d+)$/.exec(key);if(!m)return null;return {c:sheetColIndex(m[1]),r:+m[2]-1}} ``` Cell: ```js function sheetCell(r,c,create){const k=sheetKey(r,c);if(!sheet.cells[k]&&create)sheet.cells[k]={v:'',s:{}};return sheet.cells[k]} function sheetRaw(r,c){const cell=sheet.cells[sheetKey(r,c)];return cell?String(cell.v??''):''} ``` Style accessor: ```js function sheetStyle(cell){return cell.s||(cell.s={})} ``` Snapshot: ```js function sheetSnapshot(){return JSON.stringify({cells:sheet.cells,vars:sheet.vars,cols:sheet.cols,rows:sheet.rows})} function sheetPushHistory(){sheet.history.push(sheetSnapshot());if(sheet.history.length>60)sheet.history.shift();sheet.future=[]} function sheetRestore(snap){const d=JSON.parse(snap);sheet.cells=d.cells;sheet.vars=d.vars;sheet.cols=d.cols;sheet.rows=d.rows;sheet.editing=null;sheetUpdateAll()} function sheetUndo(){if(!sheet.history.length)return;sheet.future.push(sheetSnapshot());sheetRestore(sheet.history.pop())} function sheetRedo(){if(!sheet.future.length)return;sheet.history.push(sheetSnapshot());sheetRestore(sheet.future.pop())} ``` `sheetUpdateAll` clamps selection, rebuild grid? Now syntax check. Also note `sheet.dragging` pointerup listener added inside initSheetPage with window each init once—fine.

Potential issues:
- `sheetSetValue` calls sheetRefresh which calls sheetMarkDirty; commits during render? Fine.
- `sheetMarkDirty` called by `sheetRefresh` on every change, including during `renderSheetGrid`? No.
- `sheetApplyRangeStyle` pushes history even if no range changes, fine.
- `sheetPasteTSV` Math.max(...[]) when lines empty? We check after removing trailing; if text was "\n" lines becomes ['']; Math.max(...[1]) fine. If text empty return.
- `sheetShiftRefs` uses lookbehind `(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])` — supported in modern browsers. Fine.
- `sheetPdfWrap` for text with tabs: not split; okay.
- `sheetFormatValue` currency `toLocaleString` may emit non-breaking space; PDF standard Helvetica might not encode 'Rp ' okay, numerics with locale dots/commas okay. `toLocaleString('id-ID')` uses '.' thousand separator and ',' decimal. Fine.
- PDF text may contain characters not in WinAnsi, e.g. Arabic/emoji; Helvetica standard font throws on unsupported chars? pdf-lib encodes WinAnsi and may throw "WinAnsi cannot encode". Need sanitize text for PDF. The doc export has sanitizeWinAnsi function already. We should use it in export sheet for all text including sheet name. Add sanitization when building data text and title. `sanitizeWinAnsi` is function defined earlier globally (function declaration) and maps smart quotes etc. Use `sanitizeWinAnsi(view.text)` in data. Also `sheetPdfWrap` receives. Title `sanitizeWinAnsi(sheetNameValue())`. Add later.

- `sheetDisplay` uses `sheet._display` cache; cache for cell created before clear. Fine.
- Variables: `sheetUpdateVar` calls sheetRefresh which calls renderSheetGrid; after input change, focus stays in input? render grid doesn't affect var input. Good.
- `sheetAddVar` calls sheetRefresh and render vars; focuses name.
- After `sheetRestore` calls renderSheetVars and sheetRefresh; okay.
- `sheetUpdateSelectionUI` calls `sheetUpdateToolbarState`, and `sheetSyncFormula` also calls toolbar state → duplicate. Fine.
- `sheetSyncFormula` is called in render → update toolbar → color inputs set. Fine.
- When cell editing, `sheetUpdateSelectionUI` from render after selection? Not while editing except commit.
- `sheetCommitEdit` after `sheetSetValue` calls `sheetRefresh` which renders grid, so td detached and then move functions operate on model. `sheetFocusActive` at end for move branches? For move down, `sheetMove` → `sheetSelect` updates UI but does not focus. We call at end? Code: `if(move==='down')sheetMove(...)` then function ends without focus. So after Enter, focus stays on body/detached td → keyboard nav lost. Need add `sheetFocusActive()` after move. Simplest: after the if/else chain call `sheetFocusActive()` always, but for `else sheetFocusActive()` already. Rewrite:
```
if(move==='down')sheetMove(...); ... ; sheetFocusActive();
```
Repeat focus harmless. Update.

- `sheetCancelEdit` fine.
- `sheetBeginEdit` when already editing commits first; if called while current editing due to double click different cell? okay.

- Clicking a cell while editing: pointerdown commits; commit calls `sheetRefresh` and focus; then `sheetSelect` uses r/c. Fine but `sheetFocusActive` on detached? no.
- Pointerdown on cell with `e.preventDefault()` prevents click event but selection handled. Fine. Double-click still fires? Preventing pointerdown default doesn't prevent dblclick I think. It prevents focus/text selection. dblclick should still fire. Need test.

- When user clicks toolbar while editing: focusout not handled (we didn't add blur commit). Clicking toolbar button: mousedown on button moves focus from td → but td remains contenteditable; no blur commit listener. The tool click handler calls `if(sheet.editing)sheetCommitEdit()` — good. Formula bar click: td remains editing and formula focus, but no commit; typing then apply calls sheetApplyFormula: commits edit first, then sets formula value (already changed to raw at focus? focus listener `sheetSyncFormula(true)` gets raw from model, not current edited text). The uncommitted edit would be lost when apply commits it (commit reads td text, good) then formula.value overrides with formula bar content (raw old). Since syncFormula was called at focus before commit, formula value is old raw, then user types a new value; apply commits td first (value from td) then sets formula value. Good.

But editing a cell then clicking formula bar without typing: apply → commit td, then formula.value old raw (pre-edit) → overwrites new edit with old value! Sequence: start edit "123", focus formula (value set to old raw "" via syncFormula force) ; click apply → sheetApplyFormula commits edit writes "123", then sets cell to formula.value "" → loses. Edge case. Fix: on formula focus, if sheet.editing, commit edit first then sync. Add in focus listener: `if(sheet.editing)sheetCommitEdit(); sheetSyncFormula(true)`. But sheetCommitEdit calls focus active and may steal focus back from formula input? The focus event occurs after formula received focus; commit then `sheetFocusActive` (in else branch) focuses td, so user ends up in cell not formula. Hmm. Better modify: on formula focus, commit edit but do not refocus. Could add a `sheetCommitEdit` optional param `noFocus`. Simpler: in formula focus handler, capture formula value after commit:
```
formula.addEventListener('focus',()=>{ if(sheet.editing){ sheetCommitEdit(); formula.focus(); } sheetSyncFormula(true); });
```
But commit's `sheetFocusActive` steals focus then we refocus formula. okay. But formula's `value` might have typed? focus happens before typing. Then sync sets committed raw. Good.
Similarly clicking toolbar while editing commits and then applies style; commit leaves focus active cell; fine.

- There is no focusout commit for contenteditable if user clicks elsewhere outside toolbar/formula (e.g., vars panel or name input). Then sheet.editing remains while focus elsewhere. `sheetCommitEdit` will be called when next cell click or export. But clicking a variable input while editing: sheet.editing stays; typing variable value and pressing Enter → form submit; sheetAddVar pushes history and calls sheetRefresh, but the cell edit is still active in detached DOM? renderSheetGrid destroys td, uncommitted edit lost, sheet.editing still references old cell, then later commit reads null td → value '' and may clear cell. That's a bug. Add a `focusout` listener on grid or document to commit when focus leaves grid. Simplest: on `page` `focusin` if sheet.editing and target is not the editing td → commit. But commit refocuses active cell (steals focus from new target). Need no-focus commit. Let's add optional `sheetCommitEdit(move, restoreFocus=true)`. For focusin elsewhere, call `sheetCommitEdit(null,false)`.

Actually when clicking formula, focusin fires, commit without focus, then formula keeps focus. Then formula focus handler need not commit. Same for toolbar/vars. Good.

Implement:
```js
function sheetCommitEdit(move,restoreFocus=true){... if(move...) {sheetMove...; sheetFocusActive()} else if(restoreFocus) sheetFocusActive();}
```
And add page `focusin`:
```js
page.addEventListener('focusin',e=>{
 if(!sheet.editing)return;
 const td=sheetCellNode(sheet.editing.r,sheet.editing.c);
 if(td&&(e.target===td||td.contains(e.target)))return;
 sheetCommitEdit(null,false);
});
```
Careful: focusout from td when clicking toolbar triggers focusin on button; commit without focus. Toolbar click handler then sees editing null. Good.
When edit begins, td.focus triggers focusin target td → ignored.
When commit sets focus active, focusin target new active td; sheet.editing already null.
When editing and tabbing? keydown handles.

- `sheetFocusActive` sets `td.tabIndex=0` and focuses; after render, only active td tabindex 0. Good.

- `sheetUpdateSelectionUI` sets tabIndex for all cells each call. Fine.

- Selection classes rely on inline background? tint pseudo works.

- Fill color `background` inline overrides `.sheet-cell.editing{background:#fff}` due inline; editing cell with fill stays fill. fine.

- Applied border inline box-shadow overrides active outline pseudo? Active uses ::after box-shadow, separate. Good. Editing uses box-shadow class that inline overrides; still editing outline? - PDF export: `data[r][c]` style uses `cell.s` reference; fine.
- `sheetPdfWrap` and width: `font.widthOfTextAtSize` with unsupported chars may throw before sanitize; add sanitize.

- Opening sheet after export: `sheetStatus` hidden, dirty hidden. Fine.

- `document.addEventListener('keydown')` global Escape: if sheet formula input focused and user presses Escape, local keydown handler on page stops propagation; good.
- If sheet vars input focused and Escape: page keydown input branch stops propagation and blurs.
- If editing cell and Escape: local stops propagation and cancels. Good.

- `openTool('sheet')` doesn't close doc page. Could doc page be open while clicking a tool? No, overlay. Fine.

- initSheetPage called on open; it immediately calls renderSheetGrid and renderSheetVars outside? At the end: `renderSheetGrid();renderSheetVars();sheetUpdateMeta()` runs on first init only. Then openSheetPage renders again. Duplicate initial render but harmless.

- `sheet.initialized` set before event binding; if error occurs mid-binding, no retry. Unlikely.

- After clicking header, sheetFocusActive focuses active td (e.g., last row) and scrolls to it — selecting a column jumps scroll to bottom. That's bad UX. For header selection, we should not focus active td or focus the header. But keyboard nav after selecting column maybe. Better `sheetFocusActive` on header selection might scroll to last row (bottom). Could be unexpected. Instead, focus the header element? It's a th not focusable. We can call `sheetFocusActive()` with preventScroll? It uses scrollIntoView. Hmm. Selecting a column by clicking header should keep view. messages.summary:
## Objective
- Perbarui UI/UX Paperly tanpa mengganggu alur PDF/Office, termasuk memperbaiki reset progress bar.
- Ubah alur Pembuat PDF agar halaman editor tetap terbuka setelah unduhan dan hanya dapat ditutup melalui Kembali dengan konfirmasi.

## Requirements
- Gunakan navigasi hash `#home`, `#tools`, dan `#about`; hapus menu “Terakhir dipakai”.
- Pertahankan pratinjau urutan halaman Gabungkan PDF serta pratinjau hasil Gabungkan, Ekstrak, dan Putar.
- Jangan mengubah pemrosesan PDF/Office di luar perbaikan yang diperlukan.
- Pastikan tema dan animasi nyaman digunakan serta mengikuti `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Reset progress bar setelah pemrosesan selesai dan saat file baru yang valid dipilih.
- Pembuat PDF tidak langsung tertutup setelah tombol download; penutupan melalui tombol Kembali dengan dialog konfirmasi.

## Decisions
- Satu iframe sebelumnya dipakai bersama untuk pratinjau PDF; pratinjau hasil kini dirender dengan PDF.js ke canvas.
- Ekstrak dan Putar dibatasi ke satu file agar hasilnya dapat dipratinjau.
- Perubahan rentang halaman atau rotasi menghapus pratinjau lama.
- Ekspor Pembuat PDF menampilkan status unduhan, tetapi mempertahankan editor terbuka; Escape meminta konfirmasi dan Escape di dialog membatalkan.

## Work State
### Completed
- Navigasi hash, sidebar, Back/Forward, panduan singkat, dan label navigasi diperbarui.
- Pratinjau PDF Gabungkan, Ekstrak, dan Putar menggunakan PDF.js canvas dengan navigasi halaman dan zoom.
- Tema emas, favicon, `theme-color`, serta animasi reduced-motion diperbarui.
- Reset progress ditambahkan saat file valid diterima di `addFiles()`; file yang ditolak tidak mengganti pilihan sebelumnya.
- Pembuat PDF tetap terbuka setelah ekspor; tombol Kembali menampilkan dialog konfirmasi, termasuk dukungan Escape, fokus, backdrop, tema gelap, dan mobile.
- Verifikasi browser sebelumnya mencakup navigasi desktop/mobile, 20 alat, pratinjau PDF/Office, serta alur ekspor dan konfirmasi Pembuat PDF.
- `node --check app.js` dan `git diff --check` lolos; tidak ada error atau warning console pada uji browser.
- Perubahan sudah di-commit dan dipush; working tree bersih.

- `styles.css`: tampilan dialog, status ekspor, tema, dan reduced-motion.

Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

## Objective
- Perbarui UI/UX Paperly tanpa mengganggu alur PDF/Office, termasuk reset progress dan alur Pembuat PDF.
- Tambahkan PDF Sheet di “Tulis & Sunting” sebagai spreadsheet lokal dengan variabel, rumus, pemformatan, dan ekspor PDF.

## Requirements
- Pertahankan alur PDF/Office yang ada, pratinjau Gabungkan/Ekstrak/Putar, dan navigasi hash `#home`, `#tools`, `#about`.
- Reset progress setelah pemrosesan selesai dan saat file baru yang valid dipilih.
- Pembuat PDF tetap terbuka setelah unduhan; penutupan melalui Kembali dengan konfirmasi.
- PDF Sheet harus mendukung spreadsheet dengan variabel, rumus yang diinterpretasi manual, border, dan fitur spreadsheet lain.

## Decisions
- Pratinjau hasil PDF memakai PDF.js canvas; Ekstrak dan Putar dibatasi ke satu file agar hasil dapat dipratinjau.
- PDF Sheet dirancang sebagai halaman kerja penuh dengan formula bar, grid, variabel, format, operasi baris/kolom, undo/redo, dan ekspor PDF lokal.
- Rumus PDF Sheet memakai parser manual dengan fungsi seperti `SUM`, `AVERAGE`, dan `IF`; tidak menggunakan `eval`.
- Kembali/Escape pada PDF Sheet menampilkan dialog konfirmasi; data dipertahankan selama tab terbuka.

## Work State
### Completed
- Navigasi hash, sidebar, panduan singkat, tema, favicon, dan dukungan `prefers-reduced-motion` diperbarui.
- Pratinjau PDF Gabungkan, Ekstrak, dan Putar menggunakan PDF.js canvas dengan navigasi dan zoom.
- Reset progress ditambahkan saat file valid diterima; file yang ditolak tidak mengganti pilihan aktif.
- Pembuat PDF tetap terbuka setelah ekspor dan meminta konfirmasi sebelum ditutup.
- PDF Sheet telah ditambahkan ke grup “Tulis & Sunting” beserta markup, gaya terang/gelap, grid, parser rumus, variabel, pemformatan, border, operasi baris/kolom, clipboard, undo/redo, dialog keluar, dan ekspor PDF.
- `node --check app.js` dan `git diff --check` lolos setelah perubahan PDF Sheet.
- Pengujian browser awal memastikan PDF Sheet terbuka, menampilkan 640 sel, dan panel variabel terbuka.

### Active
- Lengkapi verifikasi browser PDF Sheet: input/edit sel, rumus dan variabel, seleksi rentang, format/border, undo/redo, ekspor PDF, dialog keluar, dan tampilan mobile.
- Tinjau masalah visual/interaksi dari screenshot PDF Sheet dan perbaiki temuan.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Jalankan uji browser end-to-end PDF Sheet, terutama rumus/variabel dan ekspor PDF, lalu perbaiki bug yang ditemukan.
2. Jalankan kembali pemeriksaan sintaks/diff dan tinjau perubahan sebelum menyelesaikan.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: mesin PDF Sheet, parser rumus, interaksi grid, variabel, ekspor PDF, serta alur file dan Pembuat PDF.
- `index.html`: halaman PDF Sheet, toolbar, panel variabel, dialog keluar, dan referensi aset.
- `styles.css`: tampilan PDF Sheet, tema gelap, responsif, dan reduced-motion.

## Important Context
- Perubahan PDF Sheet terbaru belum disebut telah di-commit atau dipush; perlakukan sebagai perubahan kerja yang belum dikomit.
- Server lokal berjalan pada `http://127.0.0.1:3010/#tools`; browser telah membuka PDF Sheet.
- Screenshot awal disimpan di `screenshots/sheet-open.jpg`.
- Perubahan terdahulu sudah di-commit dan dipush pada branch `opencode/44224576059`, dengan commit terbaru sebelumnya `2f955d2` dan sebelumnya `cc0a9d6`.

Great. I can reuse `loadDocFont` pattern for sheet custom fonts.

Now plan the implementation in detail.

## Data model

Cell style extended: `{f: fontKey, fs: size, wrap: 1, bd, align, color, bg, b, i, fmt}`.
Merged cells stored separately in sheet: `sheet.merges = [{r1,c1,r2,c2}]` (normalized). Need to be included in snapshot/history/restore. Only one merge per cell allowed (overlapping merges replace).

Grid render:
- For each cell, determine if it's the anchor of a merge (top-left) -> rowspan/colspan. If it's inside a merge but not anchor -> render nothing? A table with rowspan/colspan requires omitting covered cells; skipping generation of covered `<td>` is correct. But selection via pointer events on covered areas: clicking covered cell region hits anchor td. We must map selection to anchor. Easiest: when selecting a covered cell, redirect to merge anchor. Also treat selection ranges that intersect merges... for simplicity, when selecting a cell inside a merge, select the whole merge. And arrow nav into merged region selects the anchor. Copy ranges: ranges may include merged cells; the anchor spans visually but data only in anchor. Acceptable.

Alternatively render covered cells as empty td (no rowspan) and just style? For merged appearance, use rowspan/colspan.

- Wrap text: `white-space: pre-wrap` on td (CSS class or inline style); default `nowrap` with ellipsis? Currently cells use default table layout. Add style `white-space:normal;word-break:break-word` when wrap. Without wrap, use `white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis`.
- Font family and size inline style; need CSS variables or map to actual families:
  - sans -> "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif (screen), PDF Helvetica
  - serif -> Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; PDF TimesRoman
  - mono -> "Courier New", monospace; PDF Courier
  - custom: `paperly-sheet-...` family with PDF bytes.
- Font size values 9–20 maybe; default 13px screen. For PDF, size maps to 9pt default? Currently widthBase=9 for PDF. Let's set cell font size in px on screen, and PDF uses `fs*0.72` maybe. Simpler: offer sizes 10–18 with labels "10", "11"...; screen uses px; PDF uses pt = size*0.78? Let me define `sheet.cells.s.fs` as point-ish number 8–18, screen `font-size:${fs}px`, PDF `size: fs*0.78`? Hmm, then default fs=11 → 11px screen, 8.6pt PDF. Existing PDF uses 9pt. Let's set default fs=12 on screen and PDF factor 0.75 → 9pt. Good. But screen default currently likely 13px. Set DEFAULT_FS=12.5? Use integer sizes 9–18 and pdf size = fs*0.75.

Actually simpler and more predictable: style.fs stores PDF point size (9 default), screen renders `calc(fs * 1.34px)`? Inline style can use `font-size:${fs*1.3}px`. Let's offer sizes [8,9,10,11,12,14,16,18,20,24] and screen px = fs*1.35 (rounded). With default 9 → 12.15px ≈ current. I'll use `Math.round(fs*1.35*10)/10`.

Toolbar: add selects:
- `#sheetFont` (Font) with options Helvetica (Sans), Times (Serif), Courier (Mono), plus custom entries; a button `#sheetFontUpload` ("+ Font") triggering hidden file input.
- `#sheetFontSize` select with sizes.
- Buttons: wrap (`data-sact="wrap"`), merge (`data-sact="merge"`), maybe unmerge via same button toggle ("Gabung" / "Pisah"). Use one button "Gabung" with active state when selection contains merge; clicking again unmerges. Label "Gabung" icon. Add title "Gabung & tengahkan sel (tekan lagi untuk pisah)".
- "=" formula help button in formula row.

Merge semantics:
- `sheetMergeSelection()`: normalize range; if single cell -> if inside a merge -> unmerge; else no-op toast "Pilih minimal dua sel untuk digabung."
- Merge anchor gets value of top-left cell (existing). Other cells: values concatenated? Standard spreadsheet keeps only top-left. We'll keep only top-left value, but for safety, if top-left empty and another cell has content, take the first non-empty and clear others. Push history. Store merges in sheet.merges.
- Apply center alignment to anchor: set align='center'.
- Unmerge: remove merges overlapping range.
- Merge rendering: anchor td gets rowspan/colspan, other covered cells omitted. Computing merges per render: find merge whose anchor==(r,c); if cell in any merge and not anchor -> skip. Complexity O(rows*cols*merges) fine.
- In `renderSheetGrid`, `sel` and `active` for anchor: if active cell inside merge, active is anchor? We'll redirect selection in `sheetSelect` via `sheetNormalizeSelection` (if selection is inside a merge, extend anchor/sel to whole merge?). Simpler: when clicking a td, its dataset r,c is the anchor already (since covered cells aren't rendered), so selection naturally anchors. Keyboard move into merge: sheetSelect should snap to anchor when target inside merge (then optionally select entire merge on click only). For keyboard, snap to merge anchor; good.
- Range selection including merged cells: clicking a merge then shift-clicking extends from merge anchor. Fine.
- Header aria-label for merged: append " (gabungan)".
- Insert/delete row/col should update merges (shift/adjust, delete merges fully inside deleted row/col or shrink). Implement helpers.

Wrap: `style.wrap` boolean. Screen CSS `.sheet-cell.wrap` or inline. Also affects row heights naturally in HTML table (multi-line rows grow). PDF: currently always wraps text to fit column width. With wrap off, should draw single line truncated with ellipsis. Implement: `lines = style.wrap ? sheetPdfWrap(...) : [truncate(...)]`. Column width computation uses max content width; if wrap enabled, cap column width (e.g., 190 default, maybe 220) so it wraps.

PDF export enhancements with preview:

New export flow:
- Clicking "Ekspor PDF" opens preview dialog (blur backdrop) instead of directly exporting.
- Dialog content:
  - Left: preview canvas rendered from generated PDF (debounced on option change), page navigation if multiple pages.
  - Right: controls:
    - Ukuran kertas: A4, A3, Letter, Legal, F4 (Folio 215×330)
    - Orientasi: Otomatis (mengikuti tabel) / Lanskap / Potret
    - Skala tabel: Pas kanan penuh (fit width) / Ukuran asli / Rapat (compact?) Let's do "Penuhi lebar halaman" (default), "Ukuran asli", "Rapat" (compact: minimal widths and smaller font? maybe scale 0.9). Simpler: `layout`: 'fit' | 'actual'. Fit = columns stretched to usable width; actual = content width min, shrink only if overflow.
    - Border: Semua garis / Hanya luar / Horizontal / Tanpa garis (grid lines).
    - Ukuran font PDF: scale maybe select "Kecil/Normal/Besar" (0.85/1/1.15).
    - Tampilkan header kolom: checkbox (repeat on each page)
    - Tampilkan nomor baris: checkbox
    - Tampilkan judul: checkbox (sheet name)
    - Margin: select Normal/Sempit/Lebar.
    - Zebra stripes? maybe skip.
  - Buttons: Batal, Unduh PDF.
- Options persist in a `sheetPdfOptions` object (maybe localStorage? keep in memory).
- On open, build PDF with current options (async) and render page 1 into canvas with pdf.js. Show loading state.
- Page nav prev/next.
- On "Unduh PDF", generate and download; keep dialog open? User asked preview before download; on download, close dialog and show status ("PDF sudah diunduh"), keep sheet open. Maybe keep dialog open with status? Prior pattern: keep sheet open. I'd close preview after download to show sheet + toast.
- The preview dialog should use blur backdrop (`.doc-confirm-backdrop` has blur 12px). Create `sheetPdfBackdrop` with class similar but wider panel.
- Escape closes preview; focus trap basic.

PDF generation refactor: `exportSheetToPdf(report, options)` returns bytes. Need options:
```
const o = {paper:'a4', orientation:'auto'|'landscape'|'portrait', layout:'fit'|'actual', border:'all'|'outer'|'horizontal'|'none', fontScale:1, header:true, rowNumbers:true, title:true, margins:'normal'|'narrow'|'wide'}
```
Paper sizes in points: A4 [595.28,841.89], A3 [841.89,1190.55], Letter [612,792], Legal [612,1008], F4 [609.45,935.43] (215×330mm). Orientation auto: landscape if total content width > portrait usable width? Simpler: auto = landscape (since spreadsheet), but portrait option available. Better: auto chooses based on bounds: if cols<=3 and total text? Hmm. Let's define auto: landscape when cols >= 5 or content width > portrait usable*0.8, else portrait. Since default spreadsheets are wide, wedge. Also PDF preview shows result.

Page layout with title/header/footers and margins:
- margin = narrow 20, normal 32, wide 48.
- titleH = title ? 30 : 8

## Objective
- Perbarui UI/UX Paperly tanpa mengganggu alur PDF/Office yang ada.
- Tambahkan PDF Sheet sebagai spreadsheet lokal dengan variabel, rumus, pemformatan, dan ekspor PDF.

## Requirements
- Pertahankan navigasi `#home`, `#tools`, `#about`, alur PDF/Office, serta pratinjau Gabungkan/Ekstrak/Putar.
- Reset progress setelah pemrosesan selesai dan saat file baru yang valid dipilih; file yang ditolak tidak mengganti pilihan aktif.
- Pembuat PDF tetap terbuka setelah unduhan; penutupan melalui Kembali meminta konfirmasi.
- PDF Sheet mendukung variabel, rumus, border, pemformatan spreadsheet, dan ekspor PDF lokal.

## Decisions
- Pratinjau hasil PDF memakai canvas PDF.js; Ekstrak dan Putar dibatasi ke satu file agar hasil dapat dipratinjau.
- PDF Sheet memakai parser rumus manual tanpa `eval`, dengan dialog konfirmasi saat keluar dan data dipertahankan selama tab terbuka.

## Work State
### Completed
- Pembaruan UI/UX, navigasi, tema, favicon, panduan singkat, dan dukungan `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Pratinjau PDF Gabungkan/Ekstrak/Putar, reset progress, dan alur konfirmasi Pembuat PDF.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Tambahkan fitur pemformatan dan penggabungan sel pada PDF Sheet, daftar rumus yang mudah ditemukan, serta pratinjau ekspor PDF dengan pengaturan tata letak.
- Uji tuntas perubahan dan commit ke GitHub.

## Requirements
- Ganti font, termasuk mengunggah font kustom; gabung dan tengahkan sel; bungkus teks.
- Sediakan tooltip kecil saat menekan tombol sama dengan untuk melihat rumus yang tersedia.
- Sebelum menyimpan PDF, tampilkan pop-up berlatar blur dengan pratinjau dan pengaturan ukuran kertas, tata letak tabel, border, dan tampilan lainnya.
- Lakukan uji tuntas dan commit ke GitHub.

## Decisions
- Font bawaan yang ditambahkan: Sans, Serif, dan Mono; font kustom menerima file TTF/OTF.
- Pengaturan PDF ditempatkan di dalam dialog pratinjau yang sama, dengan opsi kertas, orientasi, margin, tata letak, border, skala huruf, judul, kepala kolom, dan nomor baris.

## Work State
### Completed
- Menambahkan kontrol font/ukuran huruf, unggah font, bungkus teks, dan gabung/pisah sel pada toolbar PDF Sheet.
- Menambahkan daftar rumus pada tombol `=` di bilah rumus.
- Menambahkan dialog pratinjau PDF dengan kontrol ekspor dan navigasi halaman.
- Pemeriksaan sintaks `node --check app.js` dan `git diff --check` lolos pada tahap awal perubahan.
- Browser memuat PDF Sheet dan elemen baru tanpa galat konsol pada pemeriksaan awal.

### Active
- Verifikasi lanjutan fitur format, gabung sel, dan ekspor/pratinjau PDF; beberapa hasil pemeriksaan browser terakhir tidak tersedia.
- Meninjau diff dan melakukan commit serta push perubahan baru.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Jalankan ulang uji browser untuk font bawaan/kustom, gabung-pisah sel, bungkus teks, daftar rumus, dan dialog pratinjau; perbaiki jika ada kegagalan.
2. Verifikasi PDF yang dihasilkan—jumlah halaman, ukuran/orientasi, isi teks, dan opsi border—serta uji tampilan mobile.
3. Jalankan pemeriksaan sintaks dan diff final, lalu commit dan push ke GitHub.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: logika format sel, font kustom, penggabungan sel, daftar rumus, pratinjau, dan ekspor PDF.
- `index.html`: toolbar PDF Sheet, daftar rumus, serta dialog pengaturan/pratinjau ekspor.
- `styles.css`: tampilan toolbar, daftar rumus, dan dialog pratinjau responsif.

## Important Context
- Perubahan lanjutan pada `app.js`, `index.html`, dan `styles.css` belum dikomit atau dipush dalam riwayat terbaru.
- Pengujian awal menemukan hasil yang perlu diverifikasi ulang: sel gabungan dilaporkan tanpa atribut `colspan`, dan font Serif yang dipilih terlihat tetap memakai DM Sans. Perbaikan dicoba setelahnya, tetapi hasil uji ulang tidak tercatat.
- Ekspor menggunakan `PDFDocument`, `StandardFonts`, `ensureFontkit()`, dan PDF.js untuk merender pratinjau.

- `app.js`: Cell formatting, custom fonts, merge logic, formula list, PDF preview, and export.
- `index.html`: PDF Sheet toolbar, formula list, and preview/export dialog.
- `styles.css`: Toolbar, formula list, and responsive preview dialog styling.

## Important Context
- Changes in `app.js`, `index.html`, and `styles.css` are not yet committed or pushed.
- Merge and Serif-font fixes were attempted after initial browser checks, but no follow-up verification results are available.
- PDF export uses `PDFDocument`, `StandardFonts`, `ensureFontkit()`, and PDF.js for preview rendering.

## Objective
- Complete and verify the PDF Sheet enhancements, then commit and push them to GitHub.

## Requirements
- Support Sans, Serif, Mono, and custom TTF/OTF fonts; merge and center cells; wrap text.

- PDF export options include paper size, orientation, margins, layout, borders, font scaling, title, column headers, and row numbers.

### Active
- Re-test formatting and merge behavior, especially merged-cell `colspan` and Serif rendering.
- Verify PDF rendering/export settings and mobile responsiveness.
- Review the final diff, run checks, then commit and push.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test built-in/custom fonts, merge/unmerge, wrapping, and formula list behavior.
2. Verify PDF rendering and export settings, including page count, paper size/orientation, text, borders, and mobile layout.
3. Review the diff and run syntax/diff checks.
4. Commit and push the changes to GitHub.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: Sheet formatting, merge logic, formula list, PDF preview, and export.
- `index.html`: PDF Sheet toolbar, formula list, and preview/export dialog.
- `styles.css`: Toolbar, formula list, and responsive preview dialog styling.

## Important Context
- Changes to `app.js`, `index.html`, and `styles.css` are uncommitted and have not been pushed.

## Objective
- Complete and verify the PDF Sheet enhancements, then commit and push them to GitHub.

## Requirements
- Support Sans, Serif, Mono, and custom TTF/OTF fonts; merge and center cells; wrap text.
- Show available formulas when the user presses `=`.
- Show a blurred-background PDF preview dialog with export controls before saving.

## Decisions
- Built-in font choices are Sans, Serif, and Mono; custom fonts use TTF/OTF uploads.
- PDF export options include paper size, orientation, margins, layout, borders, font scaling, title, column headers, and row numbers.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added font and font-size controls, custom font upload, text wrapping, and merge/unmerge controls.
- Added a formula list accessible from the formula bar.
- Added a PDF preview dialog with export settings and page navigation.
- `git diff --check` and `node --check app.js` passed in the prior check.

### Active
- Re-test formatting and merge behavior, especially merged-cell `colspan` and Serif rendering.
- Verify PDF rendering/export settings and mobile responsiveness.
- Review the final diff, run checks, then commit and push the changes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test built-in/custom fonts, merge/unmerge, wrapping, and formula list behavior.
2. Verify PDF rendering and export settings, including page count, paper size/orientation, text, borders, and mobile layout.
3. Review the diff and run syntax/diff checks.
4. Commit and push the changes to GitHub.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: Sheet formatting, merge logic, formula list, PDF preview, and export.
- `index.html`: PDF Sheet toolbar, formula list, and preview/export dialog.
- `styles.css`: Toolbar, formula list, and responsive preview dialog styling.

## Important Context
- Changes to `app.js`, `index.html`, and `styles.css` are uncommitted and have not been pushed.
- Current branch: `opencode/44224576059`; remote `origin` points to `https://github.com/Hattaakim/PDF-Tools-Ai-Project`.

## Objective
- Complete and verify the PDF Sheet enhancements, then commit and push them to GitHub.

## Requirements
- Support Sans, Serif, Mono, and custom TTF/OTF fonts; merge and center cells; wrap text.
- Show available formulas when the user presses `=`.
- Show a blurred-background PDF preview dialog with export controls before saving.

## Decisions
- Built-in font choices are Sans, Serif, and Mono; custom fonts use TTF/OTF uploads.
- PDF export options include paper size, orientation, margins, layout, borders, font scaling, title, column headers, and row numbers.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented font and font-size controls, custom font upload, text wrapping, and merge/unmerge controls.
- Added a formula list accessible from the formula bar.
- Added a PDF preview dialog with export settings and page navigation.
- `git diff --check` and `node --check app.js` passed in the last check.

- Review the final diff, rerun checks, then commit and push.

- (none)

1. Open PDF Sheet from the tools page and test font choices/uploads, merge/unmerge, wrapping, and formula suggestions.
2. Verify PDF preview/export settings, including page count, paper size/orientation, text, borders, and mobile layout.
3. Review changes and run `git diff --check` and `node --check app.js`.
4. Commit and push the changes to GitHub.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: Sheet formatting, merge logic, formula list, PDF preview, and export.
- `index.html`: PDF Sheet toolbar, formula list, and preview/export dialog.
- `styles.css`: Toolbar, formula list, and responsive preview dialog styling.

## Important Context
- Changes to `app.js`, `index.html`, and `styles.css` are uncommitted and have not been pushed.
- Current branch: `opencode/44224576059`; remote `origin` is `https://github.com/Hattaakim/PDF-Tools-Ai-Project`.
- Local app is available at `http://localhost:3002`; browser was at `#tools`.

content.text:
Let's look at the merge bug. `sheetMergeSelection` at line 705-718. Let me read 700-725 fully. Also `sheetSelect` snaps selection to merge anchor when clicking inside a merged cell but `extend` is false. When you select a merged range by dragging, the selection might extend beyond. The reported bug: merged cells cannot be unmerged. Why? Perhaps because after merge, `sheetMergeSelection` gets range g = normRange; clicking a merged cell sets selection to the anchor (single cell), so the exact match of the full merged range never happens. Thus exact doesn't match, and then it checks overlap and shows a toast "Rentang memuat sel gabungan..." — so users can't unmerge by clicking merged cell and pressing merge again.

Indeed: `sheetSelect` snaps to m.r1/c1 when not extending. So clicking merged cell selects only the anchor cell. Then exact range (single cell) doesn't equal the merge rectangle, overlap detected → toast, no unmerge.

Fix: In `sheetMergeSelection`, if the current selection lies within / anchor of an existing merge, and selection is a single cell within that merge (or the whole range), unmerge. Better: compute the merge containing the anchor; if the selection exactly equals the merge or is a single cell inside it, remove it. Also the toolbar "merge" active state should reflect merge at the anchor. Currently `merged` checks exact normalized range equal to a merge. For a clicked merged cell, g is single cell so not active. Should reflect `sheetMergeAt(sel.r, sel.c)`.

Also add an explicit "unmerge" path: perhaps the button label toggles title to "Pisahkan sel". Let me check HTML for the merge button.

Let me read lines 700-725 and the HTML toolbar.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

Let me identify actual bugs:

1. Custom font: `sheetEmbedFonts` uses `doc.embedFont(rec.bytes, {subset:true})` with a Uint8Array. pdf-lib's embedFont accepts Uint8Array. Fine. But `subset:true` requires fontkit with `registerFontkit`; done. One issue: the custom font is fetched via `FontFace(family, bytes.slice().buffer)`. `bytes` is Uint8Array; `.slice().buffer` is ArrayBuffer — fine.

But potential issue: `sheetApplyRangeStyle` after upload: if a selection is active, applies. The font selector adds option. However, if the user clicks "+A" while a cell is being edited, `if(sheet.editing)sheetCommitEdit()` — commit edit then apply. Fine. But after `input` file change, `e.target.value=''` resets. Fine.

Potential actual bug: fonts list in the `<select id="sheetFont">` only includes sans/serif/mono; when `sheetUpdateToolbarState` reads `style.f`, custom id may match options. Fine.

Potential actual bug: when custom font loaded, `FontFace` may reject for fonts with OpenType CFF? Browsers support OTF. Fine.

Potential bug: PDF export fails entirely if any cell has custom font but `doc.embedFont` fails (e.g., subsetting fails for some fonts) — no fallback. Could add try/catch fallback to Helvetica.

Potential bug: the PDF text is rendered using `cell.font` but in the layout prep, custom font text is `stripInvisible(raw)` — keeps unicode. OK.

But `sheetPdfTruncate` measures with custom font. Fine.

Custom font bytes: embedding the same font 4 times for r/b/i/bi? Actually it embeds once and reuses `font` object. Fine.

Another real bug: custom font fallback `|| sheetCustomFonts[0]` means if the used font is not found, it silently uses wrong font. Better: embed by exact record, and fallback to standard sans if missing.

2. Paper/layout issues:
- `totalW` width: if totalW exceeds usableW, scaling only widths but `rowHead` not scaled. Fine.
- `o.layout==='actual'` still scales down if too wide (necessary).
- Row heights do not account for merged cells rowspan when text spans multiple rows? They add needed height to last row. Fine.
- Page split: each page begins at top with header, but the table top is fixed; fine.
- `footerH=14` and footer text at y=16; bottom margin 32 so fine.
- Border 'outer' or 'horizontal' draws rectangle from `margin+footerH` but y variable is last row bottom; if last page row bottom is below margin+footerH? y never below margin+footerH because avail stops. Fine.
- Border 'horizontal': `borderRows` draws line after every row except last on page; plus outer rectangle. `borderAll` false so no vertical lines, no column headers separators. OK.
- Border 'none': still row number rectangle borders. Minor.
- With `o.border==='all'`, rectangle drawn per cell using `boxY` for merges. But when a merged cell spans rows that cross page break, boxY may be wrong: merges are kept together (groupEnd) if groupH <= avail; if taller than page it splits. Edge case.
- Column widths: `covered` cells are skipped entirely for width calculation; merged cell spanning columns only contributes in first column, so width may be narrow; but layout uses availW of span. Fine.
- Row header included in width scale? `usableW=pageW-margin*2-rowHead`; `totalW` scaled to usableW. bandW=totalW+rowHead. Fine.
- Title uses pageH-margin-10 as y baseline; titleH 30. Fine.

Potential bug: For F4, `paper` sizes. OK.

Potential bug: When o.header false, `tableTop=pageH-margin-titleH` and rows start at rowsTop=tableTop (no header). Fine.

- `drawText` y for row header: center formula uses `y+h/2-3` baseline approximation. Fine.

Maybe bigger issue: numbers alignment right but with `style.align` default removed on unmerge; the default alignment for numbers. OK.

Now "tata tabel di dalam kertas" (table layout within paper): widths computed up to 190 cap, but long headers/numbers; if totalW < usableW with layout 'fit', distribute extra equally; this may make columns too wide. Fine.

Could add horizontal margin? Already.

Maybe test the page in browser to see. But the environment may have playwright-cli. Let's see if there's a running server mechanism (start.sh uses RUNTIME_DIR scripts). Might be simplest to serve with `python3 -m http.server` and use playwright-cli to screenshot. But screenshots requirement: small JPEG ≤1280 width. We need to verify UI. Let's check playwright-cli availability.

Before that, let's decide enhancements based on request:

- Custom font: make upload robust with a visible confirmation and fallback; persist loaded fonts? The requirement says "memastikan font berhasil dimuat dan diterapkan dengan benar." Could add font list item to select and apply; already. But maybe bug: `FontFace(family,bytes.slice().buffer)` with variable fonts? Eh.

Actual bug I see: `const face=new FontFace(family,bytes.slice().buffer);` — `bytes.slice()` returns Uint8Array and `.buffer` is ArrayBuffer. Fine.

One real bug: after loading a custom font, `sheetApplyRangeStyle` sets `s.f=id`, but if the font is loaded while the formula bar is focused or no selection? Still applies to active cell.

Another real bug: In `renderSheetGrid`, when a custom font is applied, `sheetFontCss` returns `'${f.family}',sans-serif`; but `font-family:'paperly-sheet-...',sans-serif` — valid.

PDF export with custom font and bold: all variants map to same face, so `font-weight:700` won't synthesize in PDF, text same weight. Acceptable.

What if custom font fails during export? Let's add try/catch fallback to standard sans with warning toast, so export doesn't break.

Also ensure custom font is applied even when a range selection is active and the toolbar font select reflects. Already.

Maybe add a check that the custom font actually supports the text; if not, fallback glyphs missing (tofu). Hard.

3. Merge button active state: fixed. But tooltip should reflect unmerge action. Could update title/aria-pressed dynamically for accessibility. Let's add `aria-pressed` for toggle buttons (bold, italic, wrap, merge). Good improvement.

Also when hovering "status aktif saat kursor diarahkan ke sel" — they mean when the cursor (selection) is on merged cell. Fixed with sheetMergeAt.

4. Unmerge: fixed. But when unmerging, alignment resets to default. If the merged cell originally had a custom alignment before merge, we lose it. We could store previous align in the merge record when merging, then restore on unmerge. Currently merge sets align='center' always, losing prior. Requirement says "perataan teks kembali ke pengaturan awal" — probably expect default alignment, which deleting align does. But arguably restore previous. Better: save `prevAlign` in merge record; on unmerge restore if present. Let's implement: when merging, record `align: cell.s.align` (before overwrite) and maybe `style`? Keep simple: store `prevAlign` and on unmerge set align to prevAlign if defined. However existing merges lack it; delete align in that case (default). Good.

Also filter merges by identity: `merges.filter(m=>m!==target)` works since merges array items are objects; target references item. Fine.

Also unmerge when selecting multiple cells that cover a merge — works.

5. Paper size/table layout/border improvements:
Potential bug: When `o.layout==='actual'` widths sum > usableW still scale down, okay.
Potential bug: font scale affects row heights but min height 20; fine.

Maybe implement better border styles to match toolbar's per-cell borders. Export already draws per-cell `style.bd`.

But the toolbar border select has bottom only, preview border styles all/outer/horizontal/none. Perhaps unify options: add "Dalam saja" etc.? User explicitly mentions border. Could be expected to enhance preview with border color/thickness? Hmm.

The parenthetical "(ukuran kertas, tata tabel di dalam kertas, border, dsb)" likely is part of the bug-verification scope: verify paper size, table layout, border etc. So just ensure these work. I should test export and fix discovered bugs.

Basic flows are correct. So where could "tidak tepat halaman" come from? Potential edge cases:

1. **Page labels / physical page index**: Users may refer to printed page numbers in the document (e.g., roman numerals front matter), but the app only uses physical index. That's expected and hard to change.

2. **pdf-lib copyPages with pages that have `/Annots` or inherited /Rotate** – not page count.

3. **Encrypted PDFs**: `readPDF` (PDFDocument.load) throws; pdf.js preview works with empty password, showing pages; then processing fails with encrypted error. Not "wrong pages".

4. **The order in `parsePages` for manual mode when ranges are discontiguous and overlapping** – dedupe preserves first occurrence order, not sorted. E.g. "9, 2-4" produces a file with page 9 then 2,3,4, i.e. not ascending order. Is that "wrong pages"? The output pages correspond to entered order — arguably intended? The hint says "Halaman boleh di luar urutan." Hmm.

5. **Picker mode when clicking a page after loading more pages** – fine.

6. **Critical: stale `splitState.total` vs newly selected file.** When a user first selects a PDF, then selects *another* PDF, `updateSplitFile` sets `splitState.file=file` and asynchronously loads. But `splitState.rows` were set to `[{start:'1',end:'1'}]` only if rows were empty initial. If user had ranges from the previous doc like 5-8 and swaps to a 3-page PDF, ranges remain 5-8 and validation errors, not wrong output.

Wait — is `updateSplitFile()` called when files change? `addFiles` → `renderFileRows()` but does it call updateSplitFile? Let me check renderFileRows line 88. The tail was truncated. Let me check.

7. **A real likely bug: Overlapping ranges produce duplicated pages across files** – expected.

8. **A real bug: `#modalAction` double-click** → processTool runs twice? Button disabled but only after check? `processTool` begins... for split it doesn't guard. Double click could produce two downloads. Not page wrong.

9. **What about the "Pilih halaman" picker after pressing "Pilih semua" and then clearing?** fine.

10. **Big one**: In manual mode, `parsePages` accepts `1-3, 5, 8-10` and returns ids. But if user writes `1 - 3` fine. If user writes "1–3" en dash fine. If user writes "1..3"? error.

11. **What if the PDF page count exceeds splitState.total due to pdf.js failing?** no.

12. **User's range uses labels from PDF viewer that start at 1 while app index...** same.

Hmm, maybe the bug is on **ZIP archive entry ordering / duplicate names**: if the user enters overlapping identical ranges (e.g., "1-3, 1-3"), `zipped[f.name]` collides? Names include `-bagian-1` vs `-bagian-2`, distinct. Fine.

13. **The `parsePages` function dedupes across comma parts within a single range** but for manual mode each comma part is its own file. Fine.

14. Could the bug be in **`fill all`** replacing all rows with 1..total? That's intended but destructive.

15. **Picker mode "select all"**: `for p=1..total splitState.selected.add(p)` → one range 1-12 → one file. Good.

16. **Table mode blank end**: currently errors. Users might expect start-only to mean single page. Maybe the report arises because they fill "Dari" only and the app... it throws an error, so no wrong output.

17. **Off-by-one in summary vs file**? In table output, summary "3–53 hlm81 hlm2 file" is just concatenated text.

Hmm. Maybe the reported bug involves **PDFs with page rotation or different page sizes**? Let me test pages copied preserve correct content. Yes.

Maybe it's about **the number of pages in a range vs displayed**. Wait, there's a real discrepancy possibility: `parsePages` in **manual mode** uses `total` from `currentSplitRanges(pageCount)`; in `processTool`, total = pdf-lib page count. Fine.

Let me think about pdf.js `numPages` vs pdf-lib `getPageCount()` for PDFs with **linearized/object streams**—same.

Potential issue with **`copyPages` and pages containing form XObjects**? no.

Let me look at git history: maybe previous bug report was about `selectedFiles` containing multiple files for split (e.g., batch). `BATCH_TOOLS`? Let me check if 'split' is in BATCH_TOOLS. `input:'pdf'` means single. Let me check the constant.

Also, the file drop accepts multiple PDFs; `addFiles` for non-batch slices to 1. Fine.

Another angle: **"range yang diinginkan ... tidak tepat halaman"** could be due to **the user selecting pages in the picker and the app rendering thumbnails lazily with wrong page numbers**? Cards labeled p. fine.

Wait, maybe there's an issue with the **default row**: when a PDF is loaded, `splitState.rows` is set to `[{start:'1',end:'1'}]` only if it was empty. `initSplitBuilder` sets rows=[{start:'',end:''}]. Then updateSplitFile sets to 1-1. The user then edits "Dari" to 3 and "Sampai" to 5 — works. Good.

Let me inspect `renderFileRows` to see if `updateSplitFile` gets called on file add and whether old state persists across modal opens.

## Yang diperbaiki

**1. Unmerge (Gabung & Ketengahkan)**
- Klik tombol saat berada di sel mana pun dalam area gabungan kini langsung memisahkan sel, tanpa perlu memilih rentang persis.
- Perataan teks dikembalikan ke pengaturan sebelum merge (mis. kiri/kanan), bukan sekadar dihapus.
- Data sel lain yang tertutup saat merge tetap bersih, dan sel kosong tanpa gaya dihapus otomatis.

**2. Status aktif tombol Merge & Center**
- Tombol kini menyala (highlight, `aria-pressed="true"`, tooltip "Pisahkan sel gabungan") saat kursor berada di sel gabungan.
- Kembali nonaktif setelah sel dipisah, dan deteksi juga bekerja bila seleksi hanya sebagian menutupi area gabungan.

**3. Panduan rumus saat mengetik `=`**
